features.name: Бардовское вдохновение
features.description: Бонусным действием дайте другому существу в 60 футах кость d6. Оно может один раз добавить её к проверке, атаке или спасброску после броска, но до объявления результата, в течение 10 минут. Число использований равно Харизме, минимум одно; восстановление после долгого отдыха, с 5 уровня также короткого.
features.originalDescription: You can inspire others through stirring words or music. To do so, you use a bonus action on your turn to choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That creature gains one Bardic Inspiration die, a d6. Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. The creature can wait until after it rolls the d20 before deciding to use the Bardic Inspiration die, but must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails. Once the Bardic Inspiration die is rolled, it is lost. A creature can have only one Bardic Inspiration die at a time. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (a minimum of once). You regain any expended uses when you finish a long rest. Your Bardic Inspiration die changes when you reach certain levels in this class. The die becomes a d8 at 5th level, a d10 at 10th level, and a d12 at 15th level.

features.name: Использование заклинаний
features.description: Вы получаете магию класса. Выберите заговоры и заклинания в списках ниже: у каждого есть описание, время, дальность и длительность. Заговоры не тратят ячейки; остальные обычно требуют ячейку своего или более высокого круга. Число доступных выборов и ячеек рассчитано для 1 уровня редакции 2014. Известные заклинания выбираются при развитии. Замена доступна только в рамках правил класса. Бонус атаки заклинанием = мастерство + магическая характеристика, сложность спасброска = 8 + те же бонусы.
features.originalDescription: You have learned to untangle and reshape the fabric of reality in harmony with your wishes and music. Your spells are part of your vast repertoire, magic that you can tune to different situations.

features.name: Мастер на все руки
features.description: Прибавляйте половину бонуса мастерства с округлением вниз к проверкам характеристик, где он ещё не применяется. В 2024 это действует только на проверки с навыками, которыми вы не владеете; в 2014 включает инициативу.
features.originalDescription: Starting at 2nd level, you can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn’t already include your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Песнь отдыха
features.description: Во время короткого отдыха исполните успокаивающую музыку. Вы и слышащие вас союзники, потратившие кости хитов, восстанавливаете дополнительно 1d6 хитов.

features.name: Компетентность
features.description: Выберите доступные навыки, которыми уже владеете: для их проверок бонус мастерства удваивается. Два источника компетентности в одном навыке не складываются.
features.originalDescription: At 3rd level, choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. At 10th level, you can choose another two skill proficiencies to gain this benefit.

features.name: Коллегия знаний: острое словцо
features.description: Реакцией потратьте бардовское вдохновение и вычтите результат его кости из броска атаки, проверки характеристики или урона существа в пределах 60 футов. В 2014 цель должна слышать вас и не иметь иммунитета к очарованию; в 2024 применяется к видимой цели.
features.originalDescription: Also at 3rd level, you learn how to use your wit to distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one of your uses of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die and subtracting the number rolled from the creature’s roll. You can choose to use this feature after the creature makes its roll, but before the GM determines whether the attack roll or ability check succeeds or fails, or before the creature deals its damage. The creature is immune if it can’t hear you or if it’s immune to being charmed.

features.name: Улучшение характеристик или черта
features.description: +2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум, максимум 20. Вместо этого можно выбрать доступную черту.

features.name: Источник вдохновения
features.description: Бардовское вдохновение теперь восстанавливается и после короткого отдыха. В 2024 также можно без действия потратить ячейку заклинания, чтобы восстановить одно использование.
features.originalDescription: Beginning when you reach 5th level, you regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Акробатика
features.description: Удержать равновесие, пройти по узкому выступу, устоять на скользкой поверхности или выполнить акробатический трюк. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Ловкость.

features.name: Уход за животными
features.description: Успокоить животное, понять его намерения или удержать контроль над испуганным ездовым животным. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

features.name: Атлетика
features.description: Взобраться на отвесную стену, переплыть бурную реку или совершить сложный прыжок. Связан с физической силой. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Сила.

features.name: Обман
features.description: Убедительно солгать, скрыть намерения, отвлечь собеседника обманом или выдать себя за другого. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

features.name: История
features.description: Вспомнить исторические события, правителей, войны, древние цивилизации и происхождение известных мест. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

traits: +1 ко всем характеристикам.
warnings: КД рассчитан без доспехов и щита. Снаряжение, языки, инструменты и расходуемые ресурсы внесите в заметки по правилам кампании.
Один класс, фиксированный прирост хитов. Подклассы и черты — выбранная открытая подборка; мультикласс и другие книги не включены.

choices.name: Компетентность: двойной бонус мастерства
choices.description: Выберите доступные варианты. Выбор сохраняется в листе персонажа.

options.description: Вспомнить сведения о заклинаниях, магических традициях, символах, планах существования и их обитателях. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

options.name: Проницательность
options.description: Понять настроение и намерения собеседника по поведению и речи. Помогает заметить обман, но не читает мысли. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

options.name: Религия
options.description: Вспомнить сведения о богах, культах, священных символах, ритуалах и религиозных традициях. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

options.name: Запугивание
options.description: Добиться уступки угрозой или устрашающим поведением. Успех не делает собеседника дружелюбным. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

options.name: Расследование
options.description: Сопоставить улики, сделать выводы, найти скрытый механизм или понять, как устроена ловушка. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

options.name: Медицина
options.description: Распознать болезнь или причину смерти, оказать первую помощь. Для стабилизации умирающего обычно нужна проверка со сложностью 10. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

options.name: Природа
options.description: Определить растения и животных, вспомнить сведения о местности, погоде и природных циклах. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

options.name: Внимательность
options.description: Заметить спрятавшегося врага, услышать шаги или уловить другой признак опасности. Пассивное значение обычно равно 10 + бонус навыка. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

options.name: Выступление
options.description: Увлечь публику музыкой, танцем, актёрской игрой или рассказом. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

options.name: Убеждение
options.description: Договориться честными доводами, соблюсти этикет, попросить о помощи или мирно разрешить спор. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

options.name: Ловкость рук
options.description: Незаметно спрятать небольшой предмет, подбросить что-то или обчистить карман. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Ловкость.

options.name: Скрытность
options.description: Передвигаться незаметно, прятаться и избегать внимания. Нужны подходящие условия: на открытом виду спрятаться обычно нельзя. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Ловкость.

options.name: Выживание
options.description: Выслеживать существ, ориентироваться в дикой местности, находить пищу и воду, предсказывать природные опасности. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

subclasses.name: Коллегия знаний
subclasses.description: Коллегия знаний даёт дополнительные навыки и магию других классов. Острое словцо расходует бардовское вдохновение, чтобы помешать противнику. Подходит для поддержки, общения и широкого набора заклинаний.

species.name: Человек
traits: 2014: +1 ко всем характеристикам.
2024: героическое вдохновение после долгого отдыха, навык и черта происхождения на выбор.

background.name: Послушник
background.description: Служение храму и духовные традиции.

subclass.name: Коллегия знаний
subclass.description: Коллегия знаний даёт дополнительные навыки и магию других классов. Острое словцо расходует бардовское вдохновение, чтобы помешать противнику. Подходит для поддержки, общения и широкого набора заклинаний.

selectedSpells.name: Кислотная стрела · Acid Arrow
selectedSpells.description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage and no damage at the end of its next turn. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage (both initial and later) increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 2nd.
selectedSpells.summary: Кислотная стрела поражает цель дальнобойной атакой заклинанием и оставляет кислоту, которая наносит урон повторно в конце следующего хода цели. При промахе наносится уменьшенный начальный урон.

selectedSpells.name: Помощь · Aid
selectedSpells.description: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target’s hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, a target’s hit points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above 2nd.
selectedSpells.summary: До трёх существ получают +5 к текущим и максимальным хитам на 8 часов. Усиление ячейкой повышает прибавку; концентрация не требуется.

selectedSpells.name: Сигнал тревоги · Alarm
selectedSpells.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-­‐‑foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won’t set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is mental or audible. A mental alarm alerts you with a ping in your mind if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you are sleeping. An audible alarm produces the sound of a hand bell for 10 seconds within 60 feet.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает небольшую область сигнализацией: при входе неразрешённого существа вы слышите звон или получаете мысленное предупреждение. Может накладываться ритуалом.

selectedSpells.name: Изменение облика · Alter Self
selectedSpells.description: You assume a different form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration of the spell. While the spell lasts, you can end one option as an action to gain the benefits of a different one. Aquatic Adaptation. You adapt your body to an aquatic environment, sprouting gills and growing webbing between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Change Appearance. You transform your appearance. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and distinguishing characteristics, if any. You can make yourself appear as a member of another race, though none of your statistics change. You also can’t appear as a creature of a different size than you, and your basic shape stays the same; if you’re bipedal, you can’t use this spell to become quadrupedal, for instance. At any time for the duration of the spell, you can use your action to change your appearance in this way again. Natural Weapons. You grow claws, fangs, spines, horns, or a different natural weapon of your choice. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, as appropriate to the natural weapon you chose, and you are proficient with your unarmed strikes. Finally, the natural weapon is magic and you have a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls you make using it.
selectedSpells.summary: Изменяет ваше тело: можно получить водное дыхание, новый внешний облик или естественное оружие. Это физическая трансформация, а не только иллюзия.

selectedSpells.name: Дружба с животными · Animal Friendship
selectedSpells.description: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must see and hear you. If the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails. Otherwise, the beast must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the spell's duration. If you or one of your companions harms the target, the spells ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional beast t level above 1st.
selectedSpells.summary: Убедите зверя, что вы не представляете угрозы: при провале спасброска Мудрости он очарован. Урон от вас или союзников прекращает эффект.

selectedSpells.name: Посланник-животное · Animal Messenger
selectedSpells.description: By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within range, such as a squirrel, a blue jay, or a bat. You specify a location, which you must have visited, and a recipient who matches a general description, such as “a man or woman dressed in the uniform of the town guard” or “a red-­‐‑haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat.” You also speak a message of up to twenty-­‐‑five words. The target beast travels for the duration of the spell toward the specified location, covering about 50 miles per 24 hours for a flying messenger, or 25 miles for other animals. When the messenger arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, replicating the sound of your voice. The messenger speaks only to a creature matching the description you gave. If the messenger doesn’t reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the beast makes its way back to where you cast this spell. At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3nd level or higher, the duration of the spell increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2nd.
selectedSpells.summary: Небольшой зверь переносит ваше короткое устное сообщение в указанное знакомое место и передаёт подходящему адресату.

selectedSpells.name: Животные образы · Animal Shapes
selectedSpells.description: Your magic turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. You transform each target into the form of a Large or smaller beast with a challenge rating of 4 or lower. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to transform affected creatures into new forms. The transformation lasts for the duration for each target, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. You can choose a different form for each target. A target’s game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen beast, though the target retains its alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target assumes the hit points of its new form, and when it reverts to its normal form, it returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn’t reduce the creature’s normal form to 0 hit points, it isn’t knocked unconscious. The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can’t speak or cast spells. The target’s gear melds into the new form. The target can’t activate, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.
selectedSpells.summary: Превращает согласных существ в зверей. Вы можете менять их формы в течение действия; характеристики и ограничения превращения описаны в тексте редакции.

selectedSpells.name: Восставший труп · Animate Dead
selectedSpells.description: This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within range. Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an undead creature. The target becomes a skeleton if you chose bones or a zombie if you chose a corpse (the GM has the creature’s game statistics). On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you’ve given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-­‐‑hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to four creatures you have animated with this spell, rather than animating a new one. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you animate or reassert control over two additional undead creatures for each slot level above 3rd. Each of the creatures must come from a different corpse or pile of bones.
selectedSpells.summary: Поднимает скелет или зомби из останков. Повторное применение поддерживает контроль над созданной нежитью; без него контроль со временем теряется.

selectedSpells.name: Оживление вещей · Animate Objects
selectedSpells.description: Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that are not being worn or carried. Medium targets count as two objects, Large targets count as four objects, Huge targets count as eight objects. You can’t animate any object larger than Huge. Each target animates and becomes a creature under your control until the spell ends or until reduced to 0 hit points. As a bonus action, you can mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 500 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. Animated Object Statistics Size HP AC Attack Str Dex Tiny 20 18 +8 to hit, 1d4 + 4 damage4 18 Small 25 16 +6 to hit, 1d8 + 2 damage 6 14 Medium 40 13 +5 to hit, 2d6 + 1 damage10 12 Large 50 10 +6 to hit, 2d10 + 2 damage 14 10 Huge 80 10 +8 to hit, 2d12 + 4 damage 18 6 An animated object is a construct with AC, hit points, attacks, Strength, and Dexterity determined by its size. Its Constitution is 10 and its Intelligence and Wisdom are 3, and its Charisma is 1. Its speed is 30 feet; if the object lacks legs or other appendages it can use for locomotion, it instead has a flying speed of 30 feet and can hover. If the object is securely attached to a surface or a larger object, such as a chain bolted to a wall, its speed is 0. It has blindsight with a radius of 30 feet and is blind beyond that distance. When the animated object drops to 0 hit points, it reverts to its original object form, and any remaining damage carries over to its original object form. If you command an object to attack, it can make a single melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. It makes a slam attack with an attack bonus and bludgeoning damage determined by its size. The GM might rule that a specific object inflicts slashing or piercing damage based on its form. At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can animate two additional objects for each slot level above 5th.
selectedSpells.summary: Оживляет выбранные немагические предметы, чтобы они двигались и сражались по вашим приказам. Размер предметов определяет их боевые возможности.

selectedSpells.name: Преграда жизни · Antilife Shell
selectedSpells.description: A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-­‐‑ foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you and hedging out creatures other than undead and constructs. The barrier lasts for the duration. The barrier prevents an affected creature from passing or reaching through. An affected creature can cast spells or make attacks with ranged or reach weapons through the barrier. If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.
selectedSpells.summary: Подвижная преграда вокруг вас не пропускает живых существ, кроме разрешённых типов. Не останавливает дальнобойные атаки и заклинания.

selectedSpells.name: Магический меч · Arcane Sword
selectedSpells.description: You create a sword-­‐‑shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration. When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 force damage. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to move the sword up to 20 feet to a spot you can see and repeat this attack against the same target or a different one.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт парящий силовой меч, которым вы атакуете врагов на расстоянии. После появления им можно управлять бонусным действием.

selectedSpells.name: Порча · Bane
selectedSpells.description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.
selectedSpells.summary: До трёх целей при провале спасброска Харизмы вычитают 1d4 из атак и спасбросков. Требует концентрации.

selectedSpells.name: Проклятие · Bestow Curse
selectedSpells.description: You touch a creature, and that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell. When you cast this spell, choose the nature of the curse from the following options: • Choose one ability score. While cursed, the target has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability score. • While cursed, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. • While cursed, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns. If it fails, it wastes its action that turn doing nothing. • While the target is cursed, your attacks and spells deal an extra 1d8 necrotic damage to the target. A remove curse spell ends this effect. At the GM’s option, you may choose an alternative curse effect, but it should be no more powerful than those described above. The GM has final say on such a curse’s effect. At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes. If you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the duration is 8 hours. If you use a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is 24 hours. If you use a 9th level spell slot, the spell lasts until it is dispelled. Using a spell slot of 5th level or higher grants a duration that doesn’t require concentration.
selectedSpells.summary: Касанием наложите выбранное проклятие: ухудшите проверки, атаки, действия либо добавьте урон. Цель защищается спасброском Мудрости; усиление меняет срок и концентрацию.

selectedSpells.name: Слепота/глухота · Blindness/Deafness
selectedSpells.description: You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.
selectedSpells.summary: При провале спасброска Телосложения цель становится слепой или глухой. Концентрация не требуется; цель повторяет спасброски для прекращения эффекта.

selectedSpells.name: Очарование личности · Charm Person
selectedSpells.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.
selectedSpells.summary: Очаровывает гуманоида при провале спасброска Мудрости. В бою ему проще сопротивляться; после окончания он понимает, что на него воздействовали магией.

selectedSpells.name: Ясновидение · Clairvoyance
selectedSpells.description: You create an invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees). The sensor remains in place for the duration, and it can’t be attacked or otherwise interacted with. When you cast the spell, you choose seeing or hearing. You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space. As your action, you can switch between seeing and hearing. A creature that can see the sensor (such as a creature benefiting from see invisibility or truesight) sees a luminous, intangible orb about the size of your fist.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт неподвижную точку наблюдения в знакомом или очевидном месте. Через неё можно видеть либо слышать, переключая выбранное чувство.

selectedSpells.name: Понимание языков · Comprehend Languages
selectedSpells.description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text. This spell doesn’t decode secret messages in a text or a glyph, such as an arcane sigil, that isn’t part of a written language.
selectedSpells.summary: Позволяет понимать буквальный смысл устной и письменной речи. Не даёт способности говорить на чужом языке и не расшифровывает тайные коды.

selectedSpells.name: Принуждение · Compulsion
selectedSpells.description: Creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be charmed. On a failed save, a target is affected by this spell. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to designate a direction that is horizontal to you. Each affected target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn. It can take its action before it moves. After moving in this way, it can make another Wisdom saving to try to end the effect. A target isn't compelled to move into an obviously deadly hazard, such as a fire or pit, but it will provoke opportunity attacks to move in the designated direction.
selectedSpells.summary: Заставляет проваливших спасбросок существ двигаться в выбранном направлении. Можно менять направление бонусным действием, но нельзя направлять их в очевидно смертельную опасность.

selectedSpells.name: Смятение · Confusion
selectedSpells.description: This spell assaults and twists creatures’ minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action. Each creature in a 10-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw when you cast this spell or be affected by it. An affected target can’t take reactions and must roll a d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn. d10 Behavior 1 The creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a d8 and assign a direction to each die face. The creature doesn’t take an action this turn. 2–6 The creature doesn’t move or take actions this turn. 7–8 The creature uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn. 9–10 The creature can act and move normally. At the end of each of its turns, an affected target can make a Wisdom saving throw. If it succeeds, this effect ends for that target. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the radius of the sphere increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4th.
selectedSpells.summary: Сбивает поведение существ в области: провалившие спасбросок Мудрости теряют нормальный контроль над ходом и определяют действия броском по таблице.

selectedSpells.name: Лечение ран · Cure Wounds
selectedSpells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.
selectedSpells.summary: Касанием восстанавливает хиты: в 2014 1d8 + магическая характеристика, в 2024 2d8 + модификатор. Усиление ячейкой увеличивает лечение.

selectedSpells.name: Подчинение чудовища · Dominate Monster
selectedSpells.description: You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw. While the creature is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as “Attack that creature,” “Run over there,” or “Fetch that object.” If the creature completes the order and doesn’t receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability. You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn’t do anything that you don’t allow it to do. During this time, you can also cause the creature to use a reaction, but this requires you to use your own reaction as well. Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell with a 9th-­‐‑level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.
selectedSpells.summary: Подчиняет существо при провале спасброска Мудрости. Можно отдавать мысленные приказы или тратить действие на точное управление; урон даёт новый спасбросок.

selectedSpells.name: Укус взгляда · Eyebite
selectedSpells.description: For the spell’s duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dread power. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects of your choice for the duration. On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use your action to target another creature but can’t target a creature again if it has succeeded on a saving throw against this casting of eyebite. Asleep. The target falls unconscious. It wakes up if it takes any damage or if another creature uses its action to shake the sleeper awake. Panicked. The target is frightened of you. On each of its turns, the frightened creature must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest and shortest available route, unless there is nowhere to move. If the target moves to a place at least 60 feet away from you where it can no longer see you, this effect ends. Sickened. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. At the end of each of its turns, it can make another Wisdom saving throw. If it succeeds, the effect ends.
selectedSpells.summary: Магический взгляд позволяет повторно выбирать цель и усыплять, пугать или ослаблять её при провале спасброска Мудрости.

selectedSpells.name: Предвидение · Foresight
selectedSpells.description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target can’t be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Additionally, other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target for the duration. This spell immediately ends if you cast it again before its duration ends.
selectedSpells.summary: На длительный срок даёт цели преимущество на атаки, проверки и спасброски, а атаки по ней получают помеху. Концентрация не требуется.

selectedCantrips.name: Кислотные брызги · Acid Splash
selectedCantrips.description: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage. This spell’s damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
selectedCantrips.summary: Брызги кислоты поражают существ рядом друг с другом; спасбросок Ловкости позволяет избежать урона. Размер области зависит от редакции.

selectedCantrips.name: Пляшущие огоньки · Dancing Lights
selectedCantrips.description: You create up to four torch-­‐‑sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration. You can also combine the four lights into one glowing vaguely humanoid form of Medium size. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds dim light in a 10-­‐‑ foot radius. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a new spot within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light winks out if it exceeds the spell’s range.
selectedCantrips.summary: Создаёт несколько небольших огней, которые можно двигать и объединять в светящийся силуэт. Требует концентрации.

selectedCantrips.name: Свет · Light
selectedCantrips.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-­‐‑foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again or dismiss it as an action. If you target an object held or worn by a hostile creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the spell.
selectedCantrips.summary: Заставляет предмет светиться ярким и тусклым светом. Можно закрыть непрозрачным покрытием; это не урон и не солнечный свет.

selectedCantrips.name: Волшебная рука · Mage Hand
selectedCantrips.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again. You can use your action to control the hand. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. You can move the hand up to 30 feet each time you use it. The hand can’t attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
selectedCantrips.summary: Создаёт управляемую на расстоянии призрачную руку для лёгких предметов и простых манипуляций. Она не атакует и имеет ограничение веса.

selectedCantrips.name: Починка · Mending
selectedCantrips.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage. This spell can physically repair a magic item or construct, but the spell can’t restore magic to such an object.
selectedCantrips.summary: Исправляет небольшой разрыв или поломку одного предмета. Не восстанавливает утраченные магические свойства.

preparedSpells.name: Кислотная стрела · Acid Arrow
preparedSpells.description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage and no damage at the end of its next turn. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage (both initial and later) increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 2nd.
preparedSpells.summary: Кислотная стрела поражает цель дальнобойной атакой заклинанием и оставляет кислоту, которая наносит урон повторно в конце следующего хода цели. При промахе наносится уменьшенный начальный урон.

preparedSpells.name: Помощь · Aid
preparedSpells.description: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target’s hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, a target’s hit points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above 2nd.
preparedSpells.summary: До трёх существ получают +5 к текущим и максимальным хитам на 8 часов. Усиление ячейкой повышает прибавку; концентрация не требуется.

preparedSpells.name: Сигнал тревоги · Alarm
preparedSpells.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-­‐‑foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won’t set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is mental or audible. A mental alarm alerts you with a ping in your mind if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you are sleeping. An audible alarm produces the sound of a hand bell for 10 seconds within 60 feet.
preparedSpells.summary: Защищает небольшую область сигнализацией: при входе неразрешённого существа вы слышите звон или получаете мысленное предупреждение. Может накладываться ритуалом.

preparedSpells.name: Изменение облика · Alter Self
preparedSpells.description: You assume a different form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration of the spell. While the spell lasts, you can end one option as an action to gain the benefits of a different one. Aquatic Adaptation. You adapt your body to an aquatic environment, sprouting gills and growing webbing between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Change Appearance. You transform your appearance. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and distinguishing characteristics, if any. You can make yourself appear as a member of another race, though none of your statistics change. You also can’t appear as a creature of a different size than you, and your basic shape stays the same; if you’re bipedal, you can’t use this spell to become quadrupedal, for instance. At any time for the duration of the spell, you can use your action to change your appearance in this way again. Natural Weapons. You grow claws, fangs, spines, horns, or a different natural weapon of your choice. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, as appropriate to the natural weapon you chose, and you are proficient with your unarmed strikes. Finally, the natural weapon is magic and you have a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls you make using it.
preparedSpells.summary: Изменяет ваше тело: можно получить водное дыхание, новый внешний облик или естественное оружие. Это физическая трансформация, а не только иллюзия.

preparedSpells.name: Дружба с животными · Animal Friendship
preparedSpells.description: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must see and hear you. If the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails. Otherwise, the beast must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the spell's duration. If you or one of your companions harms the target, the spells ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional beast t level above 1st.
preparedSpells.summary: Убедите зверя, что вы не представляете угрозы: при провале спасброска Мудрости он очарован. Урон от вас или союзников прекращает эффект.

preparedSpells.name: Посланник-животное · Animal Messenger
preparedSpells.description: By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within range, such as a squirrel, a blue jay, or a bat. You specify a location, which you must have visited, and a recipient who matches a general description, such as “a man or woman dressed in the uniform of the town guard” or “a red-­‐‑haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat.” You also speak a message of up to twenty-­‐‑five words. The target beast travels for the duration of the spell toward the specified location, covering about 50 miles per 24 hours for a flying messenger, or 25 miles for other animals. When the messenger arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, replicating the sound of your voice. The messenger speaks only to a creature matching the description you gave. If the messenger doesn’t reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the beast makes its way back to where you cast this spell. At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3nd level or higher, the duration of the spell increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2nd.
preparedSpells.summary: Небольшой зверь переносит ваше короткое устное сообщение в указанное знакомое место и передаёт подходящему адресату.

preparedSpells.name: Животные образы · Animal Shapes
preparedSpells.description: Your magic turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. You transform each target into the form of a Large or smaller beast with a challenge rating of 4 or lower. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to transform affected creatures into new forms. The transformation lasts for the duration for each target, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. You can choose a different form for each target. A target’s game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen beast, though the target retains its alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target assumes the hit points of its new form, and when it reverts to its normal form, it returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn’t reduce the creature’s normal form to 0 hit points, it isn’t knocked unconscious. The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can’t speak or cast spells. The target’s gear melds into the new form. The target can’t activate, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.
preparedSpells.summary: Превращает согласных существ в зверей. Вы можете менять их формы в течение действия; характеристики и ограничения превращения описаны в тексте редакции.

preparedSpells.name: Восставший труп · Animate Dead
preparedSpells.description: This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within range. Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an undead creature. The target becomes a skeleton if you chose bones or a zombie if you chose a corpse (the GM has the creature’s game statistics). On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you’ve given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-­‐‑hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to four creatures you have animated with this spell, rather than animating a new one. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you animate or reassert control over two additional undead creatures for each slot level above 3rd. Each of the creatures must come from a different corpse or pile of bones.
preparedSpells.summary: Поднимает скелет или зомби из останков. Повторное применение поддерживает контроль над созданной нежитью; без него контроль со временем теряется.

preparedSpells.name: Оживление вещей · Animate Objects
preparedSpells.description: Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that are not being worn or carried. Medium targets count as two objects, Large targets count as four objects, Huge targets count as eight objects. You can’t animate any object larger than Huge. Each target animates and becomes a creature under your control until the spell ends or until reduced to 0 hit points. As a bonus action, you can mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 500 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. Animated Object Statistics Size HP AC Attack Str Dex Tiny 20 18 +8 to hit, 1d4 + 4 damage4 18 Small 25 16 +6 to hit, 1d8 + 2 damage 6 14 Medium 40 13 +5 to hit, 2d6 + 1 damage10 12 Large 50 10 +6 to hit, 2d10 + 2 damage 14 10 Huge 80 10 +8 to hit, 2d12 + 4 damage 18 6 An animated object is a construct with AC, hit points, attacks, Strength, and Dexterity determined by its size. Its Constitution is 10 and its Intelligence and Wisdom are 3, and its Charisma is 1. Its speed is 30 feet; if the object lacks legs or other appendages it can use for locomotion, it instead has a flying speed of 30 feet and can hover. If the object is securely attached to a surface or a larger object, such as a chain bolted to a wall, its speed is 0. It has blindsight with a radius of 30 feet and is blind beyond that distance. When the animated object drops to 0 hit points, it reverts to its original object form, and any remaining damage carries over to its original object form. If you command an object to attack, it can make a single melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. It makes a slam attack with an attack bonus and bludgeoning damage determined by its size. The GM might rule that a specific object inflicts slashing or piercing damage based on its form. At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can animate two additional objects for each slot level above 5th.
preparedSpells.summary: Оживляет выбранные немагические предметы, чтобы они двигались и сражались по вашим приказам. Размер предметов определяет их боевые возможности.

preparedSpells.name: Преграда жизни · Antilife Shell
preparedSpells.description: A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-­‐‑ foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you and hedging out creatures other than undead and constructs. The barrier lasts for the duration. The barrier prevents an affected creature from passing or reaching through. An affected creature can cast spells or make attacks with ranged or reach weapons through the barrier. If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.
preparedSpells.summary: Подвижная преграда вокруг вас не пропускает живых существ, кроме разрешённых типов. Не останавливает дальнобойные атаки и заклинания.

preparedSpells.name: Магический меч · Arcane Sword
preparedSpells.description: You create a sword-­‐‑shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration. When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 force damage. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to move the sword up to 20 feet to a spot you can see and repeat this attack against the same target or a different one.
preparedSpells.summary: Создаёт парящий силовой меч, которым вы атакуете врагов на расстоянии. После появления им можно управлять бонусным действием.

preparedSpells.name: Порча · Bane
preparedSpells.description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.
preparedSpells.summary: До трёх целей при провале спасброска Харизмы вычитают 1d4 из атак и спасбросков. Требует концентрации.

preparedSpells.name: Проклятие · Bestow Curse
preparedSpells.description: You touch a creature, and that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell. When you cast this spell, choose the nature of the curse from the following options: • Choose one ability score. While cursed, the target has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability score. • While cursed, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. • While cursed, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns. If it fails, it wastes its action that turn doing nothing. • While the target is cursed, your attacks and spells deal an extra 1d8 necrotic damage to the target. A remove curse spell ends this effect. At the GM’s option, you may choose an alternative curse effect, but it should be no more powerful than those described above. The GM has final say on such a curse’s effect. At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes. If you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the duration is 8 hours. If you use a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is 24 hours. If you use a 9th level spell slot, the spell lasts until it is dispelled. Using a spell slot of 5th level or higher grants a duration that doesn’t require concentration.
preparedSpells.summary: Касанием наложите выбранное проклятие: ухудшите проверки, атаки, действия либо добавьте урон. Цель защищается спасброском Мудрости; усиление меняет срок и концентрацию.

preparedSpells.name: Слепота/глухота · Blindness/Deafness
preparedSpells.description: You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.
preparedSpells.summary: При провале спасброска Телосложения цель становится слепой или глухой. Концентрация не требуется; цель повторяет спасброски для прекращения эффекта.

preparedSpells.name: Очарование личности · Charm Person
preparedSpells.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.
preparedSpells.summary: Очаровывает гуманоида при провале спасброска Мудрости. В бою ему проще сопротивляться; после окончания он понимает, что на него воздействовали магией.

preparedSpells.name: Ясновидение · Clairvoyance
preparedSpells.description: You create an invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees). The sensor remains in place for the duration, and it can’t be attacked or otherwise interacted with. When you cast the spell, you choose seeing or hearing. You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space. As your action, you can switch between seeing and hearing. A creature that can see the sensor (such as a creature benefiting from see invisibility or truesight) sees a luminous, intangible orb about the size of your fist.
preparedSpells.summary: Создаёт неподвижную точку наблюдения в знакомом или очевидном месте. Через неё можно видеть либо слышать, переключая выбранное чувство.

preparedSpells.name: Понимание языков · Comprehend Languages
preparedSpells.description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text. This spell doesn’t decode secret messages in a text or a glyph, such as an arcane sigil, that isn’t part of a written language.
preparedSpells.summary: Позволяет понимать буквальный смысл устной и письменной речи. Не даёт способности говорить на чужом языке и не расшифровывает тайные коды.

preparedSpells.name: Принуждение · Compulsion
preparedSpells.description: Creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be charmed. On a failed save, a target is affected by this spell. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to designate a direction that is horizontal to you. Each affected target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn. It can take its action before it moves. After moving in this way, it can make another Wisdom saving to try to end the effect. A target isn't compelled to move into an obviously deadly hazard, such as a fire or pit, but it will provoke opportunity attacks to move in the designated direction.
preparedSpells.summary: Заставляет проваливших спасбросок существ двигаться в выбранном направлении. Можно менять направление бонусным действием, но нельзя направлять их в очевидно смертельную опасность.

preparedSpells.name: Смятение · Confusion
preparedSpells.description: This spell assaults and twists creatures’ minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action. Each creature in a 10-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw when you cast this spell or be affected by it. An affected target can’t take reactions and must roll a d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn. d10 Behavior 1 The creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a d8 and assign a direction to each die face. The creature doesn’t take an action this turn. 2–6 The creature doesn’t move or take actions this turn. 7–8 The creature uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn. 9–10 The creature can act and move normally. At the end of each of its turns, an affected target can make a Wisdom saving throw. If it succeeds, this effect ends for that target. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the radius of the sphere increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4th.
preparedSpells.summary: Сбивает поведение существ в области: провалившие спасбросок Мудрости теряют нормальный контроль над ходом и определяют действия броском по таблице.

preparedSpells.name: Лечение ран · Cure Wounds
preparedSpells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.
preparedSpells.summary: Касанием восстанавливает хиты: в 2014 1d8 + магическая характеристика, в 2024 2d8 + модификатор. Усиление ячейкой увеличивает лечение.

preparedSpells.name: Подчинение чудовища · Dominate Monster
preparedSpells.description: You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw. While the creature is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as “Attack that creature,” “Run over there,” or “Fetch that object.” If the creature completes the order and doesn’t receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability. You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn’t do anything that you don’t allow it to do. During this time, you can also cause the creature to use a reaction, but this requires you to use your own reaction as well. Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell with a 9th-­‐‑level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.
preparedSpells.summary: Подчиняет существо при провале спасброска Мудрости. Можно отдавать мысленные приказы или тратить действие на точное управление; урон даёт новый спасбросок.

preparedSpells.name: Укус взгляда · Eyebite
preparedSpells.description: For the spell’s duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dread power. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects of your choice for the duration. On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use your action to target another creature but can’t target a creature again if it has succeeded on a saving throw against this casting of eyebite. Asleep. The target falls unconscious. It wakes up if it takes any damage or if another creature uses its action to shake the sleeper awake. Panicked. The target is frightened of you. On each of its turns, the frightened creature must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest and shortest available route, unless there is nowhere to move. If the target moves to a place at least 60 feet away from you where it can no longer see you, this effect ends. Sickened. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. At the end of each of its turns, it can make another Wisdom saving throw. If it succeeds, the effect ends.
preparedSpells.summary: Магический взгляд позволяет повторно выбирать цель и усыплять, пугать или ослаблять её при провале спасброска Мудрости.

preparedSpells.name: Предвидение · Foresight
preparedSpells.description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target can’t be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Additionally, other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target for the duration. This spell immediately ends if you cast it again before its duration ends.
preparedSpells.summary: На длительный срок даёт цели преимущество на атаки, проверки и спасброски, а атаки по ней получают помеху. Концентрация не требуется.

features.name: Бардовское вдохновение
features.description: Бонусным действием дайте другому существу в 60 футах кость d6. Оно может один раз добавить её к проверке, атаке или спасброску после броска, но до объявления результата, в течение 10 минут. Число использований равно Харизме, минимум одно; восстановление после долгого отдыха, с 5 уровня также короткого.
features.originalDescription: You can inspire others through stirring words or music. To do so, you use a bonus action on your turn to choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That creature gains one Bardic Inspiration die, a d6. Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. The creature can wait until after it rolls the d20 before deciding to use the Bardic Inspiration die, but must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails. Once the Bardic Inspiration die is rolled, it is lost. A creature can have only one Bardic Inspiration die at a time. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (a minimum of once). You regain any expended uses when you finish a long rest. Your Bardic Inspiration die changes when you reach certain levels in this class. The die becomes a d8 at 5th level, a d10 at 10th level, and a d12 at 15th level.

features.name: Использование заклинаний
features.description: Вы получаете магию класса. Выберите заговоры и заклинания в списках ниже: у каждого есть описание, время, дальность и длительность. Заговоры не тратят ячейки; остальные обычно требуют ячейку своего или более высокого круга. Число доступных выборов и ячеек рассчитано для 1 уровня редакции 2014. Известные заклинания выбираются при развитии. Замена доступна только в рамках правил класса. Бонус атаки заклинанием = мастерство + магическая характеристика, сложность спасброска = 8 + те же бонусы.
features.originalDescription: You have learned to untangle and reshape the fabric of reality in harmony with your wishes and music. Your spells are part of your vast repertoire, magic that you can tune to different situations.

features.name: Мастер на все руки
features.description: Прибавляйте половину бонуса мастерства с округлением вниз к проверкам характеристик, где он ещё не применяется. В 2024 это действует только на проверки с навыками, которыми вы не владеете; в 2014 включает инициативу.
features.originalDescription: Starting at 2nd level, you can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn’t already include your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Песнь отдыха
features.description: Во время короткого отдыха исполните успокаивающую музыку. Вы и слышащие вас союзники, потратившие кости хитов, восстанавливаете дополнительно 1d6 хитов.

features.name: Компетентность
features.description: Выберите доступные навыки, которыми уже владеете: для их проверок бонус мастерства удваивается. Два источника компетентности в одном навыке не складываются.
features.originalDescription: At 3rd level, choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. At 10th level, you can choose another two skill proficiencies to gain this benefit.

features.name: Коллегия знаний: острое словцо
features.description: Реакцией потратьте бардовское вдохновение и вычтите результат его кости из броска атаки, проверки характеристики или урона существа в пределах 60 футов. В 2014 цель должна слышать вас и не иметь иммунитета к очарованию; в 2024 применяется к видимой цели.
features.originalDescription: Also at 3rd level, you learn how to use your wit to distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one of your uses of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die and subtracting the number rolled from the creature’s roll. You can choose to use this feature after the creature makes its roll, but before the GM determines whether the attack roll or ability check succeeds or fails, or before the creature deals its damage. The creature is immune if it can’t hear you or if it’s immune to being charmed.

features.name: Улучшение характеристик или черта
features.description: +2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум, максимум 20. Вместо этого можно выбрать доступную черту.

features.name: Источник вдохновения
features.description: Бардовское вдохновение теперь восстанавливается и после короткого отдыха. В 2024 также можно без действия потратить ячейку заклинания, чтобы восстановить одно использование.
features.originalDescription: Beginning when you reach 5th level, you regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Контрочарование
features.description: В 2024 реакцией на провал спасброска от испуга или очарования вами либо союзником в 30 футах даёте повторить его с преимуществом. В 2014 нужно действие для выступления: слышащие вас союзники в 30 футах получают преимущество на такие спасброски до конца вашего следующего хода.
features.originalDescription: At 6th level, you gain the ability to use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-­‐‑influencing effects. As an action, you can start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn. During that time, you and any friendly creatures within 30 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed. A creature must be able to hear you to gain this benefit. The performance ends early if you are incapacitated or silenced or if you voluntarily end it (no action required).

features.name: Дополнительные тайны магии
features.description: Выберите два заклинания любых классов доступного вам круга, включая заговоры. Они считаются заклинаниями барда и не занимают обычное число известных заклинаний.

A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip. The chosen spells count as bard spells for you and are included in the number in the Spells Known column of the Bard table. You learn two additional spells from any class at 14th level and again at 18th level.

Roll a Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to your ability check. You can choose to do so after you roll the die for the ability check, but before the GM tells you whether you succeed or fail.

features.name: Превосходное вдохновение
features.description: В 2014 при инициативе без оставшихся вдохновений восстанавливается одно. В 2024 при инициативе восстанавливаете использования до двух, если их было меньше двух.
features.originalDescription: At 20th level, when you roll initiative and have no uses of Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one use.

features.name: Акробатика
features.description: Удержать равновесие, пройти по узкому выступу, устоять на скользкой поверхности или выполнить акробатический трюк. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Ловкость.

features.name: Уход за животными
features.description: Успокоить животное, понять его намерения или удержать контроль над испуганным ездовым животным. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

features.name: Атлетика
features.description: Взобраться на отвесную стену, переплыть бурную реку или совершить сложный прыжок. Связан с физической силой. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Сила.

features.name: Обман
features.description: Убедительно солгать, скрыть намерения, отвлечь собеседника обманом или выдать себя за другого. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

features.name: История
features.description: Вспомнить исторические события, правителей, войны, древние цивилизации и происхождение известных мест. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

features.name: Кислотная стрела · Acid Arrow
features.description: Кислотная стрела поражает цель дальнобойной атакой заклинанием и оставляет кислоту, которая наносит урон повторно в конце следующего хода цели. При промахе наносится уменьшенный начальный урон.

features.name: Кислотные брызги · Acid Splash
features.description: Брызги кислоты поражают существ рядом друг с другом; спасбросок Ловкости позволяет избежать урона. Размер области зависит от редакции.

features.name: Магия
features.description: Вспомнить сведения о заклинаниях, магических традициях, символах, планах существования и их обитателях. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

features.name: Атлетика
features.description: Взобраться на отвесную стену, переплыть бурную реку или совершить сложный прыжок. Связан с физической силой. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Сила.

features.name: Помощь · Aid
features.description: До трёх существ получают +5 к текущим и максимальным хитам на 8 часов. Усиление ячейкой повышает прибавку; концентрация не требуется.

features.name: Сигнал тревоги · Alarm
features.description: Защищает небольшую область сигнализацией: при входе неразрешённого существа вы слышите звон или получаете мысленное предупреждение. Может накладываться ритуалом.

features.name: Изменение облика · Alter Self
features.description: Изменяет ваше тело: можно получить водное дыхание, новый внешний облик или естественное оружие. Это физическая трансформация, а не только иллюзия.

features.name: Восставший труп · Animate Dead
features.description: Поднимает скелет или зомби из останков. Повторное применение поддерживает контроль над созданной нежитью; без него контроль со временем теряется.

features.name: Животные образы · Animal Shapes
features.description: Превращает согласных существ в зверей. Вы можете менять их формы в течение действия; характеристики и ограничения превращения описаны в тексте редакции.

features.name: Преграда жизни · Antilife Shell
features.description: Подвижная преграда вокруг вас не пропускает живых существ, кроме разрешённых типов. Не останавливает дальнобойные атаки и заклинания.

traits: +1 ко всем характеристикам.
warnings: КД рассчитан без доспехов и щита. Снаряжение, языки, инструменты и расходуемые ресурсы внесите в заметки по правилам кампании.
Один класс, фиксированный прирост хитов. Подклассы и черты — выбранная открытая подборка; мультикласс и другие книги не включены.

options.name: Проницательность
options.description: Понять настроение и намерения собеседника по поведению и речи. Помогает заметить обман, но не читает мысли. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

options.name: Религия
options.description: Вспомнить сведения о богах, культах, священных символах, ритуалах и религиозных традициях. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

choices.name: Коллегия знаний: три навыка
choices.description: Выберите доступные варианты. Выбор сохраняется в листе персонажа.

options.name: Запугивание
options.description: Добиться уступки угрозой или устрашающим поведением. Успех не делает собеседника дружелюбным. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

options.name: Расследование
options.description: Сопоставить улики, сделать выводы, найти скрытый механизм или понять, как устроена ловушка. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

options.name: Медицина
options.description: Распознать болезнь или причину смерти, оказать первую помощь. Для стабилизации умирающего обычно нужна проверка со сложностью 10. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

options.name: Природа
options.description: Определить растения и животных, вспомнить сведения о местности, погоде и природных циклах. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

options.name: Внимательность
options.description: Заметить спрятавшегося врага, услышать шаги или уловить другой признак опасности. Пассивное значение обычно равно 10 + бонус навыка. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

options.name: Выступление
options.description: Увлечь публику музыкой, танцем, актёрской игрой или рассказом. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

options.name: Убеждение
options.description: Договориться честными доводами, соблюсти этикет, попросить о помощи или мирно разрешить спор. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

options.name: Ловкость рук
options.description: Незаметно спрятать небольшой предмет, подбросить что-то или обчистить карман. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Ловкость.

options.name: Скрытность
options.description: Передвигаться незаметно, прятаться и избегать внимания. Нужны подходящие условия: на открытом виду спрятаться обычно нельзя. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Ловкость.

options.name: Выживание
options.description: Выслеживать существ, ориентироваться в дикой местности, находить пищу и воду, предсказывать природные опасности. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

choices.name: Тайны магии: заклинания любых классов
choices.description: Выберите доступные варианты. Выбор сохраняется в листе персонажа.

options.name: Кислотная стрела · Acid Arrow
options.description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage and no damage at the end of its next turn. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage (both initial and later) increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 2nd.
options.summary: Кислотная стрела поражает цель дальнобойной атакой заклинанием и оставляет кислоту, которая наносит урон повторно в конце следующего хода цели. При промахе наносится уменьшенный начальный урон.

options.name: Кислотные брызги · Acid Splash
options.description: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage. This spell’s damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
options.summary: Брызги кислоты поражают существ рядом друг с другом; спасбросок Ловкости позволяет избежать урона. Размер области зависит от редакции.

options.name: Помощь · Aid
options.description: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target’s hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, a target’s hit points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above 2nd.
options.summary: До трёх существ получают +5 к текущим и максимальным хитам на 8 часов. Усиление ячейкой повышает прибавку; концентрация не требуется.

options.name: Сигнал тревоги · Alarm
options.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-­‐‑foot cube.
