features.name: Боевой стиль
features.description: Постоянная боевая специализация. Выберите один стиль из доступных: точные бонусы и условия оружия или доспехов указаны в карточках. Один и тот же стиль повторно не выбирается.
features.originalDescription: At 2nd level, you adopt a style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can’t take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

features.name: Использование заклинаний
features.description: Вы получаете магию класса. Выберите заговоры и заклинания в списках ниже: у каждого есть описание, время, дальность и длительность. Заговоры не тратят ячейки; остальные обычно требуют ячейку своего или более высокого круга. Число доступных выборов и ячеек рассчитано для 2 уровня редакции 2014. Подготовленные заклинания образуют ваш текущий доступный набор; бесплатные заклинания происхождения и подкласса показаны отдельно. Бонус атаки заклинанием = мастерство + магическая характеристика, сложность спасброска = 8 + те же бонусы.
features.originalDescription: By 2nd level, you have learned to draw on divine magic through meditation and prayer to cast spells as a cleric does.

features.name: Божественная кара
features.description: После попадания рукопашным оружием можно потратить ячейку: дополнительно 2d8 излучением за 1 круг и ещё 1d8 за каждый круг выше, максимум 5d8. Против нежити и исчадий ещё +1d8, максимум 6d8. В 2014 не требует бонусного действия.
features.originalDescription: Starting at 2nd level, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon’s damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-­‐‑level spell slot, plus 1d8 for each spell level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is an undead or a fiend.

features.name: Божественное здоровье
features.description: Получаете иммунитет к болезням.

features.name: Клятва преданности: божественный канал
features.description: Раз за короткий или долгий отдых выберите эффект: Священное оружие усиливает атаки Харизмой на минуту; Изгнание нечисти действием заставляет слышащих/видящих вас исчадий и нежить в 30 футах пройти спасбросок Мудрости или бежать минуту, пока не получат урон.

features.name: Улучшение характеристик или черта
features.description: +2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум, максимум 20. Вместо этого можно выбрать доступную черту.

features.name: Дополнительная атака
features.description: Когда в свой ход совершаете действие Атака, можете атаковать дважды вместо одного раза. Это не второе действие и не удвоение атак бонусным действием.
features.originalDescription: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Оборона
features.description: +1 к КД, пока вы носите доспех.

traits: +1 ко всем характеристикам.
warnings: КД рассчитан без доспехов и щита. Снаряжение, языки, инструменты и расходуемые ресурсы внесите в заметки по правилам кампании.
Один класс, фиксированный прирост хитов. Подклассы и черты — выбранная открытая подборка; мультикласс и другие книги не включены.

choices.name: Боевой стиль
choices.description: Выберите доступные варианты. Выбор сохраняется в листе персонажа.

options.name: Оборона
options.description: +1 к КД, пока вы носите доспех.

options.name: Бой большим оружием
options.description: 2014: переброс 1 и 2 урона двуручным/универсальным оружием. 2024: 1 и 2 считаются 3.

class.name: Паладин
class.description: Священная клятва, ауры и сила веры.

subclasses.name: Клятва преданности
subclasses.description: Клятва преданности даёт защитную магию, Священное оружие и защиту союзников от очарования. Паладин усиливает оружие Божественным каналом и оберегает группу аурами.

species.name: Человек
traits: 2014: +1 ко всем характеристикам.
2024: героическое вдохновение после долгого отдыха, навык и черта происхождения на выбор.

background.name: Послушник
background.description: Служение храму и духовные традиции.

subclass.name: Клятва преданности
subclass.description: Клятва преданности даёт защитную магию, Священное оружие и защиту союзников от очарования. Паладин усиливает оружие Божественным каналом и оберегает группу аурами.

selectedSpells.name: Помощь · Aid
selectedSpells.description: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target’s hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, a target’s hit points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above 2nd.
selectedSpells.summary: До трёх существ получают +5 к текущим и максимальным хитам на 8 часов. Усиление ячейкой повышает прибавку; концентрация не требуется.

selectedSpells.name: Изгнание · Banishment
selectedSpells.description: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished. If the target is native to the plane of existence you’re on, you banish the target to a harmless demiplane. While there, the target is incapacitated. The target remains there until the spell ends, at which point the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. If the target is native to a different plane of existence than the one you’re on, the target is banished with a faint popping noise, returning to its home plane. If the spell ends before 1 minute has passed, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. Otherwise, the target doesn’t return. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.
selectedSpells.summary: При провале спасброска Харизмы временно удаляет существо на другой план. Возможность не дать ему вернуться зависит от его происхождения и правил редакции.

selectedSpells.name: Маяк надежды · Beacon of Hope
selectedSpells.description: This spell bestows hope and vitality. Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has advantage on Wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.
selectedSpells.summary: Выбранные союзники получают преимущество на спасброски Мудрости и от смерти, а любое лечение восстанавливает им максимально возможное число хитов.

selectedSpells.name: Благословение · Bless
selectedSpells.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.
selectedSpells.summary: До трёх существ добавляют 1d4 к броскам атак и спасброскам, пока вы удерживаете концентрацию. Ячейка выше 1 круга увеличивает число целей.

selectedSpells.name: Клеймящая кара · Branding Smite
selectedSpells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike. The attack deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage to the target, which becomes visible if it's invisible, and the target sheds dim light in a 5-­‐‑foot radius and can't become invisible until the spell ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.
selectedSpells.summary: Усиливает следующее подходящее попадание излучением и делает цель видимой, мешая ей скрываться невидимостью.

selectedSpells.name: Приказ · Command
selectedSpells.description: You speak a one-­‐‑word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, if it doesn’t understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it. Some typical commands and their effects follow. You might issue a command other than one described here. If you do so, the GM determines how the target behaves. If the target can’t follow your command, the spell ends. Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you. Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn. Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. Grovel. The target falls prone and then ends its turn. Halt. The target doesn’t move and takes no actions. A flying creature stays aloft, provided that it is able to do so. If it must move to stay aloft, it flies the minimum distance needed to remain in the air. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.
selectedSpells.summary: Однословная команда при провале спасброска Мудрости заставляет цель потратить следующий ход на указанное простое действие. Не позволяет приказать напрямую навредить себе.

selectedSpells.name: Общение · Commune
selectedSpells.description: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question. Divine beings aren’t necessarily omniscient, so you might receive “unclear” as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity’s knowledge. In a case where a one-­‐‑word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity’s interests, the GM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead. If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing your next long rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer. The GM makes this roll in secret.
selectedSpells.summary: Обратитесь к божественной силе с тремя вопросами, на которые можно ответить «да» или «нет». Ответ ограничен знаниями силы; частые повторения снижают надёжность.

selectedSpells.name: Создание пищи и воды · Create Food and Water
selectedSpells.description: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours. The food is bland but nourishing, and spoils if uneaten after 24 hours. The water is clean and doesn’t go bad.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт обычную пищу и чистую воду для группы. Пища недолговечна, но полноценна; заклинание не создаёт изысканных блюд.

selectedSpells.name: Дневной свет · Daylight
selectedSpells.description: A 60-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet. If you chose a point on an object you are holding or one that isn’t being worn or carried, the light shines from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the affected object with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the light. If any of this spell’s area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт большую область яркого света и рассеивает подходящую магическую тьму. В 2024 свет считается солнечным; в 2014 обычное описание этого не даёт.

selectedSpells.name: Защита от смерти · Death Ward
selectedSpells.description: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell ends. If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and the spell ends.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает от первого падения до 0 хитов, оставляя 1 хит, либо отменяет подходящий эффект мгновенной смерти. После срабатывания заклинание заканчивается.

selectedSpells.name: Рассеивание добра и зла · Dispel Evil and Good
selectedSpells.description: Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from fey, undead, and creatures originating from beyond the Material Plane. For the duration, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions. Break Enchantment. As your action, you touch a creature you can reach that is charmed, frightened, or possessed by a celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an undead. The creature you touch is no longer charmed, frightened, or possessed by such creatures. Dismissal. As your action, make a melee spell attack against a celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an undead you can reach. On a hit, you attempt to drive the creature back to its home plane. The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane (if it isn’t there already). If they aren’t on their home plane, undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and fey are sent to the Feywild.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает от сверхъестественных существ и позволяет прекратить подходящее очарование, испуг или одержимость либо попытаться изгнать пришельца на родной план.

selectedSpells.name: Рассеивание магии · Dispel Magic
selectedSpells.description: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell’s level. On a successful check, the spell ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you automatically end the effects of a spell on the target if the spell’s level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you used.
selectedSpells.summary: Прекращает действующие заклинания на цели. Эффекты до 3 круга снимаются автоматически; для более высоких нужна проверка либо усиленная ячейка.

selectedSpells.name: Небесный огонь · Flame Strike
selectedSpells.description: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify. Each creature in a 10-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius, 40-­‐‑foot-­‐‑high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 4d6 fire damage and 4d6 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the fire damage or the radiant damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.
selectedSpells.summary: Вертикальный столб огня и божественного света наносит смешанный урон огнём и излучением. Спасбросок Ловкости уменьшает его вдвое.

selectedSpells.name: Свобода перемещения · Freedom of Movement
selectedSpells.description: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target’s movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target’s speed nor cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained. The target can also spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature that has it grappled. Finally, being underwater imposes no penalties on the target’s movement or attacks.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает движение цели от магического замедления, удержания и паралича, облегчает выход из немагических захватов и перемещение под водой.

selectedSpells.name: Обет · Geas
selectedSpells.description: You place a magical command on a creature that you can see within range, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action or course of activity as you decide. If the creature can understand you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you for the duration. While the creature is charmed by you, it takes 5d10 psychic damage each time it acts in a manner directly counter to your instructions, but no more than once each day. A creature that can’t understand you is unaffected by the spell. You can issue any command you choose, short of an activity that would result in certain death. Should you issue a suicidal command, the spell ends. You can end the spell early by using an action to dismiss it. A remove curse, greater restoration, or wish spell also ends it. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th or 8th level, the duration is 1 year. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, the spell lasts until it is ended by one of the spells mentioned above.
selectedSpells.summary: Налагает длительное магическое поручение. Нарушение приказа может причинить сильный психический урон; заведомо самоубийственный приказ не действует.

selectedSpells.name: Страж веры · Guardian of Faith
selectedSpells.description: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your deity. Any creature hostile to you that moves to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 20 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The guardian vanishes when it has dealt a total of 60 damage.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт неподвижного божественного стража, который ранит приближающихся врагов излучением. Исчезает, когда израсходует установленный запас урона.

selectedSpells.name: Малое восстановление · Lesser Restoration
selectedSpells.description: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.
selectedSpells.summary: Снимает с цели одно подходящее состояние, например слепоту, глухоту, паралич или отравление. Время применения и лечение болезней зависят от редакции.

selectedSpells.name: Поиск существа · Locate Creature
selectedSpells.description: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature’s location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement. The spell can locate a specific creature known to you, or the nearest creature of a specific kind (such as a human or a unicorn), so long as you have seen such a creature up close—within 30 feet—at least once. If the creature you described or named is in a different form, such as being under the effects of a polymorph spell, this spell doesn’t locate the creature. This spell can’t locate a creature if running water at least 10 feet wide blocks a direct path between you and the creature.
selectedSpells.summary: Позволяет чувствовать направление к знакомому существу или ближайшему существу заданного вида. Есть ограничения на дальность, преграды и изменённую форму.

selectedSpells.name: Магический круг · Magic Circle
selectedSpells.description: You create a 10-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius, 20-­‐‑foot-­‐‑tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range. Glowing runes appear wherever the cylinder intersects with the floor or other surface. Choose one or more of the following types of creatures: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead. The circle affects a creature of the chosen type in the following ways: • The creature can’t willingly enter the cylinder by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to do so, it must first succeed on a Charisma saving throw. • The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets within the cylinder. • Targets within the cylinder can’t be charmed, frightened, or possessed by the creature. When you cast this spell, you can elect to cause its magic to operate in the reverse direction, preventing a creature of the specified type from leaving the cylinder and protecting targets outside it. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration increases by 1 hour for each slot level above 3rd.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт круг, мешающий выбранным сверхъестественным существам входить или выходить, атаковать и воздействовать на защищённых. Требует времени и компонентов.

selectedSpells.name: Защита от зла и добра · Protection from Evil and Good
selectedSpells.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can’t be charmed, frightened, or possessed by them. If the target is already charmed, frightened, or possessed by such a creature, the target has advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает от аберраций, небожителей, элементалей, фей, исчадий и нежити: мешает их атакам, очарованию, испугу и одержимости.

selectedSpells.name: Оживление · Raise Dead
selectedSpells.description: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days. If the creature’s soul is both willing and at liberty to rejoin the body, the creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell also neutralizes any poisons and cures nonmagical diseases that affected the creature at the time it died. This spell doesn’t, however, remove magical diseases, curses, or similar effects; if these aren’t first removed prior to casting the spell, they take effect when the creature returns to life. The spell can’t return an undead creature to life. This spell closes all mortal wounds, but it doesn’t restore missing body parts. If the creature is lacking body parts or organs integral for its survival—its head, for instance—the spell automatically fails. Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to all attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Every time the target finishes a long rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it disappears.
selectedSpells.summary: Возвращает к жизни недавно умершего при согласии души. Не восстанавливает утраченные части тела; требует дорогого компонента и накладывает временную слабость.

selectedSpells.name: Убежище · Sanctuary
selectedSpells.description: You ward a creature within range against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This spell doesn’t protect the warded creature from area effects, such as the explosion of a fireball. If the warded creature makes an attack or casts a spell that affects an enemy creature, this spell ends.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает существо: нападающий должен пройти спасбросок Мудрости или сменить цель. Наступательные действия защищённого существа прекращают эффект; области поражения обходят эту проверку.

selectedSpells.name: Область истины · Zone of Truth
selectedSpells.description: You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell’s area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can’t speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether each creature succeeds or fails on its saving throw. An affected creature is aware of the spell and can thus avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive in its answers as long as it remains within the boundaries of the truth.
selectedSpells.summary: В области правды провалившие спасбросок Харизмы не могут сознательно лгать. Вы знаете результат спасброска; цель может молчать или уклоняться от ответа.

preparedSpells.description: You speak a one-­‐‑word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, if it doesn’t understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it. Some typical commands and their effects follow. You might issue a command other than one described here. If you do so, the GM determines how the target behaves. If the target can’t follow your command, the spell ends. Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you. Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn. Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. Grovel. The target falls prone and then ends its turn. Halt. The target doesn’t move and takes no actions. A flying creature stays aloft, provided that it is able to do so. If it must move to stay aloft, it flies the minimum distance needed to remain in the air. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.
preparedSpells.summary: Однословная команда при провале спасброска Мудрости заставляет цель потратить следующий ход на указанное простое действие. Не позволяет приказать напрямую навредить себе.

preparedSpells.name: Общение · Commune
preparedSpells.description: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question. Divine beings aren’t necessarily omniscient, so you might receive “unclear” as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity’s knowledge. In a case where a one-­‐‑word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity’s interests, the GM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead. If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing your next long rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer. The GM makes this roll in secret.
preparedSpells.summary: Обратитесь к божественной силе с тремя вопросами, на которые можно ответить «да» или «нет». Ответ ограничен знаниями силы; частые повторения снижают надёжность.

preparedSpells.name: Создание пищи и воды · Create Food and Water
preparedSpells.description: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours. The food is bland but nourishing, and spoils if uneaten after 24 hours. The water is clean and doesn’t go bad.
preparedSpells.summary: Создаёт обычную пищу и чистую воду для группы. Пища недолговечна, но полноценна; заклинание не создаёт изысканных блюд.

preparedSpells.name: Дневной свет · Daylight
preparedSpells.description: A 60-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet. If you chose a point on an object you are holding or one that isn’t being worn or carried, the light shines from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the affected object with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the light. If any of this spell’s area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled.
preparedSpells.summary: Создаёт большую область яркого света и рассеивает подходящую магическую тьму. В 2024 свет считается солнечным; в 2014 обычное описание этого не даёт.

preparedSpells.name: Защита от смерти · Death Ward
preparedSpells.description: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell ends. If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and the spell ends.
preparedSpells.summary: Защищает от первого падения до 0 хитов, оставляя 1 хит, либо отменяет подходящий эффект мгновенной смерти. После срабатывания заклинание заканчивается.

preparedSpells.name: Рассеивание добра и зла · Dispel Evil and Good
preparedSpells.description: Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from fey, undead, and creatures originating from beyond the Material Plane. For the duration, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions. Break Enchantment. As your action, you touch a creature you can reach that is charmed, frightened, or possessed by a celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an undead. The creature you touch is no longer charmed, frightened, or possessed by such creatures. Dismissal. As your action, make a melee spell attack against a celestial, an elemental, a fey, a fiend, or an undead you can reach. On a hit, you attempt to drive the creature back to its home plane. The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane (if it isn’t there already). If they aren’t on their home plane, undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and fey are sent to the Feywild.
preparedSpells.summary: Защищает от сверхъестественных существ и позволяет прекратить подходящее очарование, испуг или одержимость либо попытаться изгнать пришельца на родной план.

preparedSpells.name: Рассеивание магии · Dispel Magic
preparedSpells.description: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell’s level. On a successful check, the spell ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you automatically end the effects of a spell on the target if the spell’s level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you used.
preparedSpells.summary: Прекращает действующие заклинания на цели. Эффекты до 3 круга снимаются автоматически; для более высоких нужна проверка либо усиленная ячейка.

preparedSpells.name: Небесный огонь · Flame Strike
preparedSpells.description: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify. Each creature in a 10-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius, 40-­‐‑foot-­‐‑high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 4d6 fire damage and 4d6 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the fire damage or the radiant damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.
preparedSpells.summary: Вертикальный столб огня и божественного света наносит смешанный урон огнём и излучением. Спасбросок Ловкости уменьшает его вдвое.

preparedSpells.name: Свобода перемещения · Freedom of Movement
preparedSpells.description: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target’s movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target’s speed nor cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained. The target can also spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature that has it grappled. Finally, being underwater imposes no penalties on the target’s movement or attacks.
preparedSpells.summary: Защищает движение цели от магического замедления, удержания и паралича, облегчает выход из немагических захватов и перемещение под водой.

preparedSpells.name: Обет · Geas
preparedSpells.description: You place a magical command on a creature that you can see within range, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action or course of activity as you decide. If the creature can understand you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you for the duration. While the creature is charmed by you, it takes 5d10 psychic damage each time it acts in a manner directly counter to your instructions, but no more than once each day. A creature that can’t understand you is unaffected by the spell. You can issue any command you choose, short of an activity that would result in certain death. Should you issue a suicidal command, the spell ends. You can end the spell early by using an action to dismiss it. A remove curse, greater restoration, or wish spell also ends it. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th or 8th level, the duration is 1 year. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, the spell lasts until it is ended by one of the spells mentioned above.
preparedSpells.summary: Налагает длительное магическое поручение. Нарушение приказа может причинить сильный психический урон; заведомо самоубийственный приказ не действует.

preparedSpells.name: Страж веры · Guardian of Faith
preparedSpells.description: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your deity. Any creature hostile to you that moves to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 20 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The guardian vanishes when it has dealt a total of 60 damage.
preparedSpells.summary: Создаёт неподвижного божественного стража, который ранит приближающихся врагов излучением. Исчезает, когда израсходует установленный запас урона.

preparedSpells.name: Малое восстановление · Lesser Restoration
preparedSpells.description: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.
preparedSpells.summary: Снимает с цели одно подходящее состояние, например слепоту, глухоту, паралич или отравление. Время применения и лечение болезней зависят от редакции.

preparedSpells.name: Поиск существа · Locate Creature
preparedSpells.description: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature’s location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement. The spell can locate a specific creature known to you, or the nearest creature of a specific kind (such as a human or a unicorn), so long as you have seen such a creature up close—within 30 feet—at least once. If the creature you described or named is in a different form, such as being under the effects of a polymorph spell, this spell doesn’t locate the creature. This spell can’t locate a creature if running water at least 10 feet wide blocks a direct path between you and the creature.
preparedSpells.summary: Позволяет чувствовать направление к знакомому существу или ближайшему существу заданного вида. Есть ограничения на дальность, преграды и изменённую форму.

preparedSpells.name: Магический круг · Magic Circle
preparedSpells.description: You create a 10-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius, 20-­‐‑foot-­‐‑tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range. Glowing runes appear wherever the cylinder intersects with the floor or other surface. Choose one or more of the following types of creatures: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead. The circle affects a creature of the chosen type in the following ways: • The creature can’t willingly enter the cylinder by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to do so, it must first succeed on a Charisma saving throw. • The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets within the cylinder. • Targets within the cylinder can’t be charmed, frightened, or possessed by the creature. When you cast this spell, you can elect to cause its magic to operate in the reverse direction, preventing a creature of the specified type from leaving the cylinder and protecting targets outside it. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration increases by 1 hour for each slot level above 3rd.
preparedSpells.summary: Создаёт круг, мешающий выбранным сверхъестественным существам входить или выходить, атаковать и воздействовать на защищённых. Требует времени и компонентов.

preparedSpells.name: Защита от зла и добра · Protection from Evil and Good
preparedSpells.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can’t be charmed, frightened, or possessed by them. If the target is already charmed, frightened, or possessed by such a creature, the target has advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.
preparedSpells.summary: Защищает от аберраций, небожителей, элементалей, фей, исчадий и нежити: мешает их атакам, очарованию, испугу и одержимости.

preparedSpells.name: Оживление · Raise Dead
preparedSpells.description: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days. If the creature’s soul is both willing and at liberty to rejoin the body, the creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell also neutralizes any poisons and cures nonmagical diseases that affected the creature at the time it died. This spell doesn’t, however, remove magical diseases, curses, or similar effects; if these aren’t first removed prior to casting the spell, they take effect when the creature returns to life. The spell can’t return an undead creature to life. This spell closes all mortal wounds, but it doesn’t restore missing body parts. If the creature is lacking body parts or organs integral for its survival—its head, for instance—the spell automatically fails. Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to all attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Every time the target finishes a long rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it disappears.
preparedSpells.summary: Возвращает к жизни недавно умершего при согласии души. Не восстанавливает утраченные части тела; требует дорогого компонента и накладывает временную слабость.

preparedSpells.name: Убежище · Sanctuary
preparedSpells.description: You ward a creature within range against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This spell doesn’t protect the warded creature from area effects, such as the explosion of a fireball. If the warded creature makes an attack or casts a spell that affects an enemy creature, this spell ends.
preparedSpells.summary: Защищает существо: нападающий должен пройти спасбросок Мудрости или сменить цель. Наступательные действия защищённого существа прекращают эффект; области поражения обходят эту проверку.

preparedSpells.name: Область истины · Zone of Truth
preparedSpells.description: You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell’s area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can’t speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether each creature succeeds or fails on its saving throw. An affected creature is aware of the spell and can thus avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive in its answers as long as it remains within the boundaries of the truth.
preparedSpells.summary: В области правды провалившие спасбросок Харизмы не могут сознательно лгать. Вы знаете результат спасброска; цель может молчать или уклоняться от ответа.

features.name: Божественное чувство
features.description: Действием до конца следующего хода определяйте местоположение небожителей, исчадий и нежити в 60 футах без полного укрытия, а также освящённые и осквернённые места. Число применений = 1 + Харизма; восстановление после долгого отдыха.
features.originalDescription: The presence of strong evil registers on your senses like a noxious odor, and powerful good rings like heavenly music in your ears. As an action, you can open your awareness to detect such forces. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet of you that is not behind total cover. You know the type (celestial, fiend, or undead) of any being whose presence you sense, but not its identity (the vampire Count Strahd von Zarovich, for instance). Within the same radius, you also detect the presence of any place or object that has been consecrated or desecrated, as with the hallow spell. You can use this feature a number of times equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier. When you finish a long rest, you regain all expended uses.

features.name: Наложение рук
features.description: Запас лечения равен 5 × уровень паладина, восстанавливается после долгого отдыха. Касанием распределяете нужное число хитов. В 2014 требуется действие, в 2024 бонусное действие. За 5 очков можно убрать яд; в 2014 также болезнь.

features.name: Боевой стиль
features.description: Постоянная боевая специализация. Выберите один стиль из доступных: точные бонусы и условия оружия или доспехов указаны в карточках. Один и тот же стиль повторно не выбирается.
features.originalDescription: At 2nd level, you adopt a style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can’t take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

features.name: Использование заклинаний
features.description: Вы получаете магию класса. Выберите заговоры и заклинания в списках ниже: у каждого есть описание, время, дальность и длительность. Заговоры не тратят ячейки; остальные обычно требуют ячейку своего или более высокого круга. Число доступных выборов и ячеек рассчитано для 2 уровня редакции 2014. Подготовленные заклинания образуют ваш текущий доступный набор; бесплатные заклинания происхождения и подкласса показаны отдельно. Бонус атаки заклинанием = мастерство + магическая характеристика, сложность спасброска = 8 + те же бонусы.
features.originalDescription: By 2nd level, you have learned to draw on divine magic through meditation and prayer to cast spells as a cleric does.

features.name: Божественная кара
features.description: После попадания рукопашным оружием можно потратить ячейку: дополнительно 2d8 излучением за 1 круг и ещё 1d8 за каждый круг выше, максимум 5d8. Против нежити и исчадий ещё +1d8, максимум 6d8. В 2014 не требует бонусного действия.
features.originalDescription: Starting at 2nd level, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon’s damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-­‐‑level spell slot, plus 1d8 for each spell level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is an undead or a fiend.

features.name: Божественное здоровье
features.description: Получаете иммунитет к болезням.

features.name: Клятва преданности: божественный канал
features.description: Раз за короткий или долгий отдых выберите эффект: Священное оружие усиливает атаки Харизмой на минуту; Изгнание нечисти действием заставляет слышащих/видящих вас исчадий и нежить в 30 футах пройти спасбросок Мудрости или бежать минуту, пока не получат урон.

features.name: Улучшение характеристик или черта
features.description: +2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум, максимум 20. Вместо этого можно выбрать доступную черту.

features.name: Дополнительная атака
features.description: Когда в свой ход совершаете действие Атака, можете атаковать дважды вместо одного раза. Это не второе действие и не удвоение атак бонусным действием.
features.originalDescription: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Аура защиты
features.description: Вы и союзники в 10 футах добавляете модификатор Харизмы паладина (минимум +1) ко всем спасброскам, пока аура действует. На 18 уровне радиус становится 30 футов. Ауры нескольких паладинов не складываются.
features.originalDescription: Starting at 6th level, whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Charisma modifier (with a minimum bonus of +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Аура преданности
features.description: Вы и союзники в Ауре защиты не можете быть очарованы, пока аура действует.
features.originalDescription: Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can’t be charmed while you are conscious. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Улучшение характеристик или черта
features.description: +2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум, максимум 20. Вместо этого можно выбрать доступную черту.

features.name: Аура отваги
features.description: Вы и союзники внутри Ауры защиты не можете быть испуганы, пока аура действует.
features.originalDescription: Starting at 10th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can’t be frightened while you are conscious. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Улучшенная божественная кара
features.description: Каждое попадание рукопашным оружием наносит дополнительно 1d8 излучением. Этот урон складывается с Божественной карой за ячейку.
features.originalDescription: By 11th level, you are so suffused with righteous might that all your melee weapon strikes carry divine power with them. Whenever you hit a creature with a melee weapon, the creature takes an extra 1d8 radiant damage. If you also use your Divine Smite with an attack, you add this damage to the extra damage of your Divine Smite.

features.name: Улучшение характеристик или черта
features.description: +2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум, максимум 20. Вместо этого можно выбрать доступную черту.

features.name: Очищающее касание
features.description: Действием касанием прекратите одно заклинание на себе или согласном существе. Число применений = Харизма, минимум одно; восстановление после долгого отдыха.
features.originalDescription: Beginning at 14th level, you can use your action to end one spell on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (a minimum of once). You regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Чистота духа
features.description: На вас постоянно действует защита, аналогичная Защите от зла и добра: перечисленные в ней типы существ атакуют вас с помехой и не могут очаровывать, пугать или вселяться в вас.

features.name: Улучшение характеристик или черта
features.description: +2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум, максимум 20. Вместо этого можно выбрать доступную черту.

features.name: Увеличение аур до 30 фт.
features.description: Радиус Ауры защиты и связанных с ней аур увеличивается с 10 до 30 футов.

features.name: Улучшение характеристик или черта
features.description: +2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум, максимум 20. Вместо этого можно выбрать доступную черту.

features.name: Священный нимб
features.description: На минуту усиливает ауру: она излучает солнечный свет и наносит врагам 10 урона излучением в начале их ходов. В 2014 действие, раз за долгий отдых; в 2024 бонусное действие, повтор доступен также за ячейку 5 круга. Дополнительные защитные эффекты приведены в правилах редакции.
features.originalDescription: At 20th level, as an action, you can emanate an aura of sunlight. For 1 minute, bright light shines from you in a 30-­‐‑foot radius, and dim light shines 30 feet beyond that. Whenever an enemy creature starts its turn in the bright light, the creature takes 10 radiant damage. In addition, for the duration, you have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by fiends or undead. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest. Breaking Your Oath A paladin tries to hold to the highest standards of conduct, but even the most virtuous paladin is fallible. Sometimes the right path proves too demanding, sometimes a situation calls for the lesser of two evils, and sometimes the heat of emotion causes a paladin to transgress his or her oath. A paladin who has broken a vow typically seeks absolution from a cleric who shares his or her faith or from another paladin of the same order. The paladin might spend an all-­‐ night vigil in prayer as a sign of penitence, or undertake a fast or similar act of self-­‐denial. After a rite of confession and forgiveness, the paladin starts fresh. If a paladin willfully violates his or her oath and shows no sign of repentance, the consequences can be more serious. At the GM’s discretion, an impenitent paladin might be forced to abandon this class and adopt another.

features.name: Оборона

features.originalDescription: Beginning at 1st level, you have significant experience studying, tracking, hunting, and even talking to a certain type of enemy. Choose a type of favored enemy: aberrations, beasts, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, monstrosities, oozes, plants, or undead. features.name: Исследователь природы
features.description: Выберите любимую местность. При проверках Интеллекта или Мудрости о ней удваивайте мастерство, если им владеете. При путешествии не менее часа группа не замедляется труднопроходимой местностью и не теряется немагически; вы сохраняете бдительность, лучше добываете пищу и выслеживаете.
features.originalDescription: You are particularly familiar with one type of natural environment and are adept at traveling and surviving in such regions. Choose one type of favored terrain: arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, or swamp. When you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check related to your favored terrain, your proficiency bonus is doubled if you are using a skill that you’re proficient in. While traveling for an hour or more in your favored terrain, you gain the following benefits: • Difficult terrain doesn’t slow your group’s travel. • Your group can’t become lost except by magical means. • Even when you are engaged in another activity while traveling (such as foraging, navigating, or tracking), you remain alert to danger. • If you are traveling alone, you can move stealthily at a normal pace. • When you forage, you find twice as much food as you normally would. • While tracking other creatures, you also learn their exact number, their sizes, and how long ago they passed through the area. You choose additional favored terrain types at 6th and 10th level.

selectedSpells.name: Сигнал тревоги · Alarm
selectedSpells.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-­‐‑foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won’t set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is mental or audible. A mental alarm alerts you with a ping in your mind if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you are sleeping. An audible alarm produces the sound of a hand bell for 10 seconds within 60 feet.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает небольшую область сигнализацией: при входе неразрешённого существа вы слышите звон или получаете мысленное предупреждение. Может накладываться ритуалом.

selectedSpells.name: Дружба с животными · Animal Friendship
selectedSpells.description: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must see and hear you. If the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails. Otherwise, the beast must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the spell's duration. If you or one of your companions harms the target, the spells ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional beast t level above 1st.
selectedSpells.summary: Убедите зверя, что вы не представляете угрозы: при провале спасброска Мудрости он очарован. Урон от вас или союзников прекращает эффект.

selectedSpells.name: Посланник-животное · Animal Messenger
selectedSpells.description: By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within range, such as a squirrel, a blue jay, or a bat. You specify a location, which you must have visited, and a recipient who matches a general description, such as “a man or woman dressed in the uniform of the town guard” or “a red-­‐‑haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat.” You also speak a message of up to twenty-­‐‑five words. The target beast travels for the duration of the spell toward the specified location, covering about 50 miles per 24 hours for a flying messenger, or 25 miles for other animals. When the messenger arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, replicating the sound of your voice. The messenger speaks only to a creature matching the description you gave. If the messenger doesn’t reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the beast makes its way back to where you cast this spell. At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3nd level or higher, the duration of the spell increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2nd.
selectedSpells.summary: Небольшой зверь переносит ваше короткое устное сообщение в указанное знакомое место и передаёт подходящему адресату.

selectedSpells.name: Лечение ран · Cure Wounds
selectedSpells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.
selectedSpells.summary: Касанием восстанавливает хиты: в 2014 1d8 + магическая характеристика, в 2024 2d8 + модификатор. Усиление ячейкой увеличивает лечение.

features.originalDescription: At 2nd level, you adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can’t take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

features.name: Использование заклинаний
features.description: Вы получаете магию класса. Выберите заговоры и заклинания в списках ниже: у каждого есть описание, время, дальность и длительность. Заговоры не тратят ячейки; остальные обычно требуют ячейку своего или более высокого круга. Число доступных выборов и ячеек рассчитано для 2 уровня редакции 2014. Известные заклинания выбираются при развитии. Замена доступна только в рамках правил класса. Бонус атаки заклинанием = мастерство + магическая характеристика, сложность спасброска = 8 + те же бонусы.
features.originalDescription: By the time you reach 2nd level, you have learned to use the magical essence of nature to cast spells, much as a druid does.

features.name: Первозданная осведомлённость
features.description: Действием потратьте ячейку: на число минут по её кругу чувствуете присутствие аберраций, небожителей, драконов, элементалей, фей, исчадий и нежити в 1 миле (6 миль в любимой местности). Не определяет количество и местоположение.
features.originalDescription: Beginning at 3rd level, you can use your action and expend one ranger spell slot to focus your awareness on the region around you. For 1 minute per level of the spell slot you expend, you can sense whether the following types of creatures are present within 1 mile of you (or within up to 6 miles if you are in your favored terrain): aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. This feature doesn’t reveal the creatures’ location or number.

features.name: Добыча охотника
features.description: Выберите приём охотника. Убийца колоссов добавляет 1d8 одному попаданию за ход по уже раненой цели; Сокрушитель орд позволяет раз за ход атаковать соседнего с целью противника. В 2014 также есть Убийца великанов. Точные условия показаны в карточках.
features.originalDescription: At 3rd level, you gain one of the following features of your choice. Colossus Slayer. Your tenacity can wear down the most potent foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra 1d8 damage if it’s below its hit point maximum. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn. Giant Killer. When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet of you hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to attack that creature immediately after its attack, provided that you can see the creature. Horde Breaker. Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within range of your weapon.

features.name: Улучшение характеристик или черта
features.description: +2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум, максимум 20. Вместо этого можно выбрать доступную черту.

features.name: Дополнительная атака
features.description: Когда в свой ход совершаете действие Атака, можете атаковать дважды вместо одного раза. Это не второе действие и не удвоение атак бонусным действием.
features.originalDescription: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Аберрации
features.description: Аберрации — чуждые миру существа, например аболет. Преимущество на Выживание для выслеживания и на проверки Интеллекта для сведений об этом типе; также изучаете подходящий язык.

features.name: Арктика
features.description: Арктика: удваивайте мастерство в подходящих проверках Интеллекта и Мудрости. При путешествии от часа группа не замедляется труднопроходимой местностью и не теряется немагически; вы сохраняете бдительность, лучше ищете пищу и следы.

features.name: Стрельба
features.description: +2 к броскам атак дальнобойным оружием.

features.name: Убийца колоссов
features.description: Раз за ход попадание оружием по цели, у которой хитов меньше максимума, наносит дополнительно 1d8 урона.

traits: +1 ко всем характеристикам.
warnings: КД рассчитан без доспехов и щита. Снаряжение, языки, инструменты и расходуемые ресурсы внесите в заметки по правилам кампании.
Один класс, фиксированный прирост хитов. Подклассы и черты — выбранная открытая подборка; мультикласс и другие книги не включены.

options.name: Бой двумя оружиями
options.description: Добавьте модификатор характеристики к урону дополнительной атаки вторым оружием.

options.description: Раз в каждый свой ход после атаки оружием можно тем же оружием атаковать другое существо в 5 футах от первой цели и в пределах дальности вашего оружия.

options.name: Убийца великанов
options.description: Когда Большое или более крупное существо в 5 футах промахивается по вам атакой, реакцией атакуйте его своим оружием.

class.name: Следопыт
class.description: Следы, выживание, оружие и магия природы.

subclasses.name: Охотник
subclasses.description: Охотник выбирает боевые приёмы против разных угроз: дополнительный урон, противодействие крупным врагам или нескольким противникам и защитные умения. Доступные варианты показаны на соответствующем уровне.

species.name: Человек
traits: 2014: +1 ко всем характеристикам.
2024: героическое вдохновение после долгого отдыха, навык и черта происхождения на выбор.

background.name: Послушник
background.description: Служение храму и духовные традиции.

subclass.name: Охотник
subclass.description: Охотник выбирает боевые приёмы против разных угроз: дополнительный урон, противодействие крупным врагам или нескольким противникам и защитные умения. Доступные варианты показаны на соответствующем уровне.

selectedSpells.name: Сигнал тревоги · Alarm
selectedSpells.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-­‐‑foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won’t set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is mental or audible. A mental alarm alerts you with a ping in your mind if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you are sleeping. An audible alarm produces the sound of a hand bell for 10 seconds within 60 feet.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает небольшую область сигнализацией: при входе неразрешённого существа вы слышите звон или получаете мысленное предупреждение. Может накладываться ритуалом.

selectedSpells.name: Дружба с животными · Animal Friendship
selectedSpells.description: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must see and hear you. If the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails. Otherwise, the beast must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the spell's duration. If you or one of your companions harms the target, the spells ends. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional beast t level above 1st.
selectedSpells.summary: Убедите зверя, что вы не представляете угрозы: при провале спасброска Мудрости он очарован. Урон от вас или союзников прекращает эффект.

selectedSpells.name: Посланник-животное · Animal Messenger
selectedSpells.description: By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within range, such as a squirrel, a blue jay, or a bat. You specify a location, which you must have visited, and a recipient who matches a general description, such as “a man or woman dressed in the uniform of the town guard” or “a red-­‐‑haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat.” You also speak a message of up to twenty-­‐‑five words. The target beast travels for the duration of the spell toward the specified location, covering about 50 miles per 24 hours for a flying messenger, or 25 miles for other animals. When the messenger arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, replicating the sound of your voice. The messenger speaks only to a creature matching the description you gave. If the messenger doesn’t reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the beast makes its way back to where you cast this spell. At Higher Levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3nd level or higher, the duration of the spell increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2nd.
selectedSpells.summary: Небольшой зверь переносит ваше короткое устное сообщение в указанное знакомое место и передаёт подходящему адресату.

selectedSpells.name: Дубовая кора · Barkskin
selectedSpells.description: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target’s skin has a rough, bark-­‐‑like appearance, and the target’s AC can’t be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing.
selectedSpells.summary: Магическая кора устанавливает минимальную защиту цели. Сравните её с обычным КД: формулы не складываются; точный минимум и концентрация зависят от редакции.

selectedSpells.name: Общение с природой · Commune with Nature
selectedSpells.description: You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the land within 3 miles of you. In caves and other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet. The spell doesn’t function where nature has been replaced by construction, such as in dungeons and towns. You instantly gain knowledge of up to three facts of your choice about any of the following subjects as they relate to the area: • terrain and bodies of water • prevalent plants, minerals, animals, or peoples • powerful celestials, fey, fiends, elementals, or undead • influence from other planes of existence • buildings For example, you could determine the location of powerful undead in the area, the location of major sources of safe drinking water, and the location of any nearby towns.
selectedSpells.summary: Получите сведения об окружающей природе: местности, водоёмах, поселениях или присутствии выбранных существ. Радиус зависит от открытого пространства или подземелья.

selectedSpells.name: Призыв животных · Conjure Animals
selectedSpells.description: You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose one of the following options for what appears: • One beast of challenge rating 2 or lower • Two beasts of challenge rating 1 or lower • Four beasts of challenge rating 1/2 or lower • Eight beasts of challenge rating 1/4 or lower Each beast is also considered fey, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which has its own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions. The GM has the creatures’ statistics. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using certain higher-­‐‑level spell slots, you choose one of the summoning options above, and more creatures appear: twice as many with a 5th-­‐‑level slot, three times as many with a 7th-­‐‑level slot, and four times as many with a 9th-­‐‑level slot.
selectedSpells.summary: Магия звериных духов. В 2014 призывает зверей с отдельными ходами; в 2024 создаёт движущуюся стаю духов, чья область ранит врагов.

selectedSpells.name: Призыв лесных обитателей · Conjure Woodland Beings
selectedSpells.description: You summon fey creatures that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose one of the following options for what appears: • One fey creature of challenge rating 2 or lower • Two fey creatures of challenge rating 1 or lower • Four fey creatures of challenge rating 1/2 or lower • Eight fey creatures of challenge rating 1/4 or lower A summoned creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which have their own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions. The GM has the creatures’ statistics. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using certain higher-­‐‑level spell slots, you choose one of the summoning options above, and more creatures appear: twice as many with a 6th-­‐‑level slot and three times as many with an 8th-­‐‑level slot.
selectedSpells.summary: В 2014 призывает лесных фей. В 2024 окружает вас духами, наносящими урон выбранным врагам, и даёт Отход бонусным действием.

selectedSpells.name: Лечение ран · Cure Wounds
selectedSpells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.
selectedSpells.summary: Касанием восстанавливает хиты: в 2014 1d8 + магическая характеристика, в 2024 2d8 + модификатор. Усиление ячейкой увеличивает лечение.

selectedSpells.name: Дневной свет · Daylight
selectedSpells.description: A 60-­‐‑foot-­‐‑radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet. If you chose a point on an object you are holding or one that isn’t being worn or carried, the light shines from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the affected object with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the light. If any of this spell’s area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт большую область яркого света и рассеивает подходящую магическую тьму. В 2024 свет считается солнечным; в 2014 обычное описание этого не даёт.

selectedSpells.name: Свобода перемещения · Freedom of Movement
selectedSpells.description: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target’s movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target’s speed nor cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained. The target can also spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature that has it grappled. Finally, being underwater imposes no penalties on the target’s movement or attacks.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает движение цели от магического замедления, удержания и паралича, облегчает выход из немагических захватов и перемещение под водой.

selectedSpells.name: Древесный путь · Tree Stride
selectedSpells.description: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be living and at least the same size as you. You must use 5 feet of movement to enter a tree. You instantly know the location of all other trees of the same kind within 500 feet and, as part of the move used to enter the tree, can either pass into one of those trees or step out of the tree you’re in. You appear in a spot of your choice within 5 feet of the destination tree, using another 5 feet of movement. If you have no movement left, you appear within 5 feet of the tree you entered. You can use this transportation ability once per round for the duration. You must end each turn outside a tree.
selectedSpells.summary: Позволяет входить в деревья и выходить из других деревьев того же вида в пределах дальности, быстро перемещаясь через лес.
