If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you’ve given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to four creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating a new creature. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You animate or reassert control over two additional Undead creatures for each spell slot level above 3. Each of the creatures must come from a different corpse or pile of bones.
selectedSpells.summary: Поднимает скелет или зомби из останков. Повторное применение поддерживает контроль над созданной нежитью; без него контроль со временем теряется.

selectedSpells.name: Преграда магии · Antimagic Field
selectedSpells.description: An aura of antimagic surrounds you in 10-foot Emanation. No one can cast spells, take Magic actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura, and those things can’t target or otherwise affect anything inside it. Magical properties of magic items don’t work inside the aura or on anything inside it. Areas of effect created by spells or other magic can’t extend into the aura, and no one can teleport into or out of it or use planar travel there. Portals close temporarily while in the aura. Ongoing spells, except those cast by an Artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the area. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn’t function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration. Dispel Magic has no effect on the aura, and the auras created by different Antimagic Field spells don’t nullify each other.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт вокруг вас область подавления магии: большинство заклинаний и магических предметов внутри временно не действует. Есть исключения для артефактов и божественной силы.

selectedSpells.name: Проекция в астрал · Astral Projection
selectedSpells.description: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane (the spell ends instantly if you are already on that plane). Each target’s body is left behind in a state of suspended animation; it has the Unconscious condition, doesn’t need food or air, and doesn’t age. A target’s astral form resembles its body in almost every way, replicating its game statistics and possessions. The principal difference is the addition of a silvery cord that trails from between the shoulder blades of the astral form. The cord fades from view after 1 foot. If the cord is cut—which happens only when an effect states that it does so—the target’s body and astral form both die. A target’s astral form can travel through the Astral Plane. The moment an astral form leaves that plane, the target’s body and possessions travel along the silver cord, causing the target to re-enter its body on the new plane. Any damage or other effects that apply to an astral form have no effect on the target’s body and vice versa. If a target’s body or astral form drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends for that target. The spell ends for all the targets if you take a Magic action to dismiss it. When the spell ends for a target who isn’t dead, the target reappears in its body and exits the state of suspended animation.
selectedSpells.summary: Отделяет астральные тела группы от физических тел и позволяет путешествовать по Астралу. Физические тела остаются без сознания под защитой заклинания.

selectedSpells.name: Гадание · Augury
selectedSpells.description: You receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The GM chooses the omen from the Omens table. Omens Omen For Results That Will Be … Weal Good Woe Bad Weal and woe Good and bad Indifference Neither good nor bad The spell doesn’t account for circumstances, such as other spells, that might change the results. If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.
selectedSpells.summary: Ритуальное гадание оценивает последствия конкретного плана на ближайшие полчаса: благо, беда, оба исхода или ни один. Не учитывает все будущие вмешательства.

selectedSpells.name: Аура жизни · Aura of Life
selectedSpells.description: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic damage, and your Hit Point maximums can’t be reduced. If an ally with 0 Hit Points starts its turn in the aura, that ally regains 1 Hit Point.
selectedSpells.summary: Аура помогает союзникам против некротического урона и снижения максимума хитов; начинающее ход внутри живое существо с 0 хитов может восстановить 1 хит.

selectedSpells.name: Порча · Bane
selectedSpells.description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must each make a Charisma saving throw. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or save. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
selectedSpells.summary: До трёх целей при провале спасброска Харизмы вычитают 1d4 из атак и спасбросков. Требует концентрации.

selectedSpells.name: Изгнание · Banishment
selectedSpells.description: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the Incapacitated condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn’t return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (GM’s choice) associated with its creature type. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.
selectedSpells.summary: При провале спасброска Харизмы временно удаляет существо на другой план. Возможность не дать ему вернуться зависит от его происхождения и правил редакции.

selectedSpells.name: Маяк надежды · Beacon of Hope
selectedSpells.description: Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws and regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing.
selectedSpells.summary: Выбранные союзники получают преимущество на спасброски Мудрости и от смерти, а любое лечение восстанавливает им максимально возможное число хитов.

selectedSpells.name: Проклятие · Bestow Curse
selectedSpells.description: You touch a creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration. Until the curse ends, the target suffers one of the following effects of your choice: • Choose one ability. The target has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability. • The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. • In combat, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns or be forced to take the Dodge action on that turn. • If you deal damage to the target with an attack roll or a spell, the target takes an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If you cast this spell using a level 4 spell slot, you can maintain Concentration on it for up to 10 minutes. If you use a level 5+ spell slot, the spell doesn’t require Concentration, and the duration becomes 8 hours (level 5–6 slot) or 24 hours (level 7–8 slot). If you use a level 9 spell slot, the spell lasts until dispelled.
selectedSpells.summary: Касанием наложите выбранное проклятие: ухудшите проверки, атаки, действия либо добавьте урон. Цель защищается спасброском Мудрости; усиление меняет срок и концентрацию.

selectedSpells.name: Стена клинков · Blade Barrier
selectedSpells.description: You create a wall of whirling blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides Three-Quarters Cover, and its space is Difficult Terrain. Any creature in the wall’s space makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes that save if it enters the wall’s space or ends it turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт стену вращающихся клинков: труднопроходимую местность, укрытие и рубящий урон при опасном контакте. Спасбросок Ловкости уменьшает урон.

selectedSpells.name: Благословение · Bless
selectedSpells.description: You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
selectedSpells.summary: До трёх существ добавляют 1d4 к броскам атак и спасброскам, пока вы удерживаете концентрацию. Ячейка выше 1 круга увеличивает число целей.

selectedSpells.name: Слепота/глухота · Blindness/Deafness
selectedSpells.description: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has the Blinded or Deafened condition (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.
selectedSpells.summary: При провале спасброска Телосложения цель становится слепой или глухой. Концентрация не требуется; цель повторяет спасброски для прекращения эффекта.

selectedSpells.name: Умиротворение · Calm Emotions
selectedSpells.description: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature): • The creature has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the spell ends. If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed for the duration. • The creature becomes Indifferent about creatures of your choice that it’s Hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage. When the spell ends, the creature’s attitude returns to normal.
selectedSpells.summary: Подавляет сильные эмоции у гуманоидов: может временно снять влияние страха или очарования либо сделать враждебных существ безразличными. Урон способен нарушить успокоение.

selectedSpells.name: Приказ · Command
selectedSpells.description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. Choose the command from these options: Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you. Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn. Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. Grovel. The target has the Prone condition and then ends its turn. Halt. On its turn, the target doesn’t move and takes no action or Bonus Action. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can affect one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
selectedSpells.summary: Однословная команда при провале спасброска Мудрости заставляет цель потратить следующий ход на указанное простое действие. Не позволяет приказать напрямую навредить себе.

selectedSpells.name: Общение · Commune
selectedSpells.description: You contact a deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question. Divine beings aren’t necessarily omniscient, so you might receive “unclear” as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity’s knowledge. In a case where a one-word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity’s interests, the GM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead. If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.
selectedSpells.summary: Обратитесь к божественной силе с тремя вопросами, на которые можно ответить «да» или «нет». Ответ ограничен знаниями силы; частые повторения снижают надёжность.

selectedSpells.name: Призыв небожителя · Conjure Celestial
selectedSpells.description: You conjure a spirit from the Upper Planes, which manifests as a pillar of light in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. For each creature you can see in the Cylinder, choose which of these lights shines on it: Healing Light. The target regains Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Searing Light. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d12 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the spell ends, Bright Light fills the Cylinder, and when you move on your turn, you can also move the Cylinder up to 30 feet. Whenever the Cylinder moves into the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Cylinder or ends its turn there, you can bathe it in one of the lights. A creature can be affected by this spell only once per turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing and damage increase by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 7.
selectedSpells.summary: Магия небесного союзника. В 2014 призывает небожителя; в 2024 создаёт область небесной энергии, которую можно использовать для урона врагам и лечения союзников.

selectedSpells.name: Заражение · Contagion
selectedSpells.description: Your touch inflicts a magical contagion. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 11d8 Necrotic damage and have the Poisoned condition. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. While Poisoned, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws made with the chosen ability. The target must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or failures. If the target succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends on the target. If the target fails three of the saves, the spell lasts for 7 days on it. Whenever the Poisoned target receives an effect that would end the Poisoned condition, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or the Poisoned condition doesn’t end on it.
selectedSpells.summary: Заражает цель магической болезнью. Спасброски Телосложения определяют продолжение и прекращение последствий; эффект конкретной редакции описан ниже.

selectedSpells.name: Вечный огонь · Continual Flame
selectedSpells.description: A flame springs from an object that you touch. The effect casts Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. It looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and consumes no fuel. The flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт постоянное магическое пламя, которое светит, но не греет и не расходует топливо. Требует расходуемого компонента.

selectedSpells.name: Власть над водами · Control Water
selectedSpells.description: Until the spell ends, you control any water inside an area you choose that is a Cube up to 100 feet on a side, using one of the following effects. As a Magic action on your later turns, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one. Flood. You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If you choose an area in a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave’s path are carried with it to the other side. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a 25 percent chance of capsizing. The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. If this effect produced a wave, the wave repeats on the start of your next turn while the flood effect lasts. Part Water. You part water in the area and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell’s area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. The water then slowly fills in the trench over the course of the next round until the normal water level is restored. Redirect Flow. You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. The water in the area moves as you direct it, but once it moves beyond the spell’s area, it resumes its flow based on the terrain. The water continues to move in the direction you chose until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. Whirlpool. You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area, which must be at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. The whirlpool lasts until you choose a different effect or the spell ends. The whirlpool is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Any creature in the water and within 25 feet of the whirlpool is pulled 10 feet toward it. When a creature enters the whirlpool for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d8 Bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature can swim away from the whirlpool only if it first takes an action to pull away and succeeds on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC.
selectedSpells.summary: Управляйте водой в большой области: поднимайте уровень, разделяйте, меняйте течение или создавайте водоворот. Способ управления можно менять действием.

selectedSpells.name: Создание или уничтожение воды · Create or Destroy Water
selectedSpells.description: You do one of the following: Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there. Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт или уничтожает воду в подходящем объёме, в том числе дождём в небольшой области. Не извлекает жидкость из живого существа.

selectedSpells.name: Лечение ран · Cure Wounds
selectedSpells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.
selectedSpells.summary: Касанием восстанавливает хиты: в 2014 1d8 + магическая характеристика, в 2024 2d8 + модификатор. Усиление ячейкой увеличивает лечение.

selectedSpells.name: Защита от смерти · Death Ward
selectedSpells.description: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends, the target instead drops to 1 Hit Point, and the spell ends. If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against the target, and the spell ends.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает от первого падения до 0 хитов, оставляя 1 хит, либо отменяет подходящий эффект мгновенной смерти. После срабатывания заклинание заканчивается.

selectedSpells.name: Рассеивание добра и зла · Dispel Evil and Good
selectedSpells.description: For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions. Break Enchantment. As a Magic action, you touch a creature that is possessed by or has the Charmed or Frightened condition from one or more creatures of the types above. The target is no longer possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such creatures. Dismissal. As a Magic action, you target one creature you can see within 5 feet of you that has one of the creature types above. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane if it isn’t there already. If they aren’t on their home plane, Undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and Fey are sent to the Feywild.
selectedSpells.summary: Защищает от сверхъестественных существ и позволяет прекратить подходящее очарование, испуг или одержимость либо попытаться изгнать пришельца на родной план.

selectedSpells.name: Врата · Gate
selectedSpells.description: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose. The portal lasts for the duration, and the portal’s destination is visible through it. The portal has a front and a back on each plane where it appears. Travel through the portal is possible only by moving through its front. Anything that does so is instantly transported to the other plane, appearing in the unoccupied space nearest to the portal. Deities and other planar rulers can prevent portals created by this spell from opening in their presence or anywhere within their domains. When you cast this spell, you can speak the name of a specific creature (a pseudonym, title, or nickname doesn’t work). If that creature is on a plane other than the one you are on, the portal opens next to the named creature and transports it to the nearest unoccupied space on your side of the portal. You gain no special power over the creature, and it is free to act as the GM deems appropriate. It might leave, attack you, or help you.
selectedSpells.summary: Открывает большой портал на другой план. Может вызвать конкретное существо по истинному имени, но не даёт автоматического контроля над ним.

selectedSpells.name: Высшее восстановление · Greater Restoration
selectedSpells.description: You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it: • 1 Exhaustion level • The Charmed or Petrified condition • A curse, including the target’s Attunement to a cursed magic item • Any reduction to one of the target’s ability scores • Any reduction to the target’s Hit Point maximum
selectedSpells.summary: Снимает один из тяжёлых эффектов: истощение, определённые проклятия, снижение характеристик или максимума здоровья, окаменение либо очарование. Требует дорогого расходуемого компонента.

selectedSpells.name: Малое восстановление · Lesser Restoration
selectedSpells.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.
selectedSpells.summary: Снимает с цели одно подходящее состояние, например слепоту, глухоту, паралич или отравление. Время применения и лечение болезней зависят от редакции.

selectedSpells.name: Множественное лечение ран · Mass Cure Wounds
selectedSpells.description: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you can see within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each target regains Hit Points equal to 5d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.
selectedSpells.summary: Лечит до шести выбранных существ в области одним действием. Объём лечения зависит от редакции и круга ячейки.

selectedSpells.name: Массовое полное исцеление · Mass Heal
selectedSpells.description: A flood of healing energy flows from you into creatures around you. You restore up to 700 Hit Points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell also have the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions removed from them.
selectedSpells.summary: Распределяет огромный запас исцеления между видимыми существами и снимает указанные физические недуги. Не позволяет превысить максимум здоровья каждой цели.

selectedSpells.name: Множественное лечащее слово · Mass Healing Word
selectedSpells.description: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 3.
selectedSpells.summary: Бонусным действием на расстоянии лечит до шести видимых существ. Удобно для одновременной помощи нескольким упавшим союзникам.

selectedSpells.name: Слово силы: исцеление · Power Word Heal
selectedSpells.description: A wave of healing energy washes over one creature you can see within range. The target regains all its Hit Points. If the creature has the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned condition, the condition ends. If the creature has the Prone condition, it can use its Reaction to stand up.
selectedSpells.summary: Мощное слово полностью восстанавливает хиты цели и прекращает ряд тяжёлых состояний. Может помочь немедленно подняться с земли.

selectedSpells.name: Возрождение · Revivify
selectedSpells.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can’t revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
selectedSpells.summary: Возвращает существо, умершее не более минуты назад, с 1 хитом. Требует алмазов и не восстанавливает отсутствующие части тела.

selectedCantrips.name: Указание · Guidance
selectedCantrips.description: You touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using the chosen skill.
selectedCantrips.summary: Помогает проверке навыка, добавляя 1d4. В 2014 предназначен для одной проверки характеристики, в 2024 применяется к выбранному навыку в течение действия.

selectedCantrips.name: Свет · Light
selectedCantrips.description: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn’t being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
selectedCantrips.summary: Заставляет предмет светиться ярким и тусклым светом. Можно закрыть непрозрачным покрытием; это не урон и не солнечный свет.

selectedCantrips.name: Починка · Mending
selectedCantrips.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage. This spell can physically repair a magic item, but it can’t restore magic to such an object.
selectedCantrips.summary: Исправляет небольшой разрыв или поломку одного предмета. Не восстанавливает утраченные магические свойства.

selectedCantrips.name: Сопротивление · Resistance
selectedCantrips.description: You touch a willing creature and choose a damage type: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder. When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by 1d4. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.
selectedCantrips.summary: Помогает против опасности: в 2014 добавляет 1d4 к одному спасброску; в 2024 уменьшает получаемый урон выбранного типа по правилам заклинания.

selectedCantrips.name: Священное пламя · Sacred Flame
selectedCantrips.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this save. Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).
selectedCantrips.summary: Священное пламя наносит излучение при провале спасброска Ловкости. Укрытие не помогает этому спасброску.

preparedSpells.name: Помощь · Aid
preparedSpells.description: Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target’s Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Each target’s Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2.
preparedSpells.summary: До трёх существ получают +5 к текущим и максимальным хитам на 8 часов. Усиление ячейкой повышает прибавку; концентрация не требуется.

preparedSpells.name: Восставший труп · Animate Dead
preparedSpells.description: Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid within range. The target becomes an Undead creature: a Skeleton if you chose bones or a Zombie if you chose a corpse (see “Monsters” for the stat blocks). On each of your turns, you can take a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you’ve given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to four creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating a new creature. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You animate or reassert control over two additional Undead creatures for each spell slot level above 3. Each of the creatures must come from a different corpse or pile of bones.
preparedSpells.summary: Поднимает скелет или зомби из останков. Повторное применение поддерживает контроль над созданной нежитью; без него контроль со временем теряется.

preparedSpells.name: Преграда магии · Antimagic Field
preparedSpells.description: An aura of antimagic surrounds you in 10-foot Emanation. No one can cast spells, take Magic actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura, and those things can’t target or otherwise affect anything inside it. Magical properties of magic items don’t work inside the aura or on anything inside it. Areas of effect created by spells or other magic can’t extend into the aura, and no one can teleport into or out of it or use planar travel there. Portals close temporarily while in the aura. Ongoing spells, except those cast by an Artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the area. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn’t function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration. Dispel Magic has no effect on the aura, and the auras created by different Antimagic Field spells don’t nullify each other.
preparedSpells.summary: Создаёт вокруг вас область подавления магии: большинство заклинаний и магических предметов внутри временно не действует. Есть исключения для артефактов и божественной силы.

preparedSpells.name: Проекция в астрал · Astral Projection
preparedSpells.description: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane (the spell ends instantly if you are already on that plane). Each target’s body is left behind in a state of suspended animation; it has the Unconscious condition, doesn’t need food or air, and doesn’t age. A target’s astral form resembles its body in almost every way, replicating its game statistics and possessions. The principal difference is the addition of a silvery cord that trails from between the shoulder blades of the astral form. The cord fades from view after 1 foot. If the cord is cut—which happens only when an effect states that it does so—the target’s body and astral form both die. A target’s astral form can travel through the Astral Plane. The moment an astral form leaves that plane, the target’s body and possessions travel along the silver cord, causing the target to re-enter its body on the new plane. Any damage or other effects that apply to an astral form have no effect on the target’s body and vice versa. If a target’s body or astral form drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends for that target. The spell ends for all the targets if you take a Magic action to dismiss it. When the spell ends for a target who isn’t dead, the target reappears in its body and exits the state of suspended animation.
preparedSpells.summary: Отделяет астральные тела группы от физических тел и позволяет путешествовать по Астралу. Физические тела остаются без сознания под защитой заклинания.

preparedSpells.name: Гадание · Augury
preparedSpells.description: You receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The GM chooses the omen from the Omens table. Omens Omen For Results That Will Be … Weal Good Woe Bad Weal and woe Good and bad Indifference Neither good nor bad The spell doesn’t account for circumstances, such as other spells, that might change the results. If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.
preparedSpells.summary: Ритуальное гадание оценивает последствия конкретного плана на ближайшие полчаса: благо, беда, оба исхода или ни один. Не учитывает все будущие вмешательства.

preparedSpells.name: Аура жизни · Aura of Life
preparedSpells.description: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic damage, and your Hit Point maximums can’t be reduced. If an ally with 0 Hit Points starts its turn in the aura, that ally regains 1 Hit Point.
preparedSpells.summary: Аура помогает союзникам против некротического урона и снижения максимума хитов; начинающее ход внутри живое существо с 0 хитов может восстановить 1 хит.

preparedSpells.name: Порча · Bane
preparedSpells.description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must each make a Charisma saving throw. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or save. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
preparedSpells.summary: До трёх целей при провале спасброска Харизмы вычитают 1d4 из атак и спасбросков. Требует концентрации.

preparedSpells.name: Изгнание · Banishment
preparedSpells.description: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the Incapacitated condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn’t return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (GM’s choice) associated with its creature type. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.
preparedSpells.summary: При провале спасброска Харизмы временно удаляет существо на другой план. Возможность не дать ему вернуться зависит от его происхождения и правил редакции.

preparedSpells.name: Маяк надежды · Beacon of Hope
preparedSpells.description: Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws and regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing.
preparedSpells.summary: Выбранные союзники получают преимущество на спасброски Мудрости и от смерти, а любое лечение восстанавливает им максимально возможное число хитов.

preparedSpells.name: Проклятие · Bestow Curse
preparedSpells.description: You touch a creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration. Until the curse ends, the target suffers one of the following effects of your choice: • Choose one ability. The target has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability. • The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. • In combat, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns or be forced to take the Dodge action on that turn. • If you deal damage to the target with an attack roll or a spell, the target takes an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If you cast this spell using a level 4 spell slot, you can maintain Concentration on it for up to 10 minutes. If you use a level 5+ spell slot, the spell doesn’t require Concentration, and the duration becomes 8 hours (level 5–6 slot) or 24 hours (level 7–8 slot). If you use a level 9 spell slot, the spell lasts until dispelled.
preparedSpells.summary: Касанием наложите выбранное проклятие: ухудшите проверки, атаки, действия либо добавьте урон. Цель защищается спасброском Мудрости; усиление меняет срок и концентрацию.

preparedSpells.name: Стена клинков · Blade Barrier
preparedSpells.description: You create a wall of whirling blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides Three-Quarters Cover, and its space is Difficult Terrain. Any creature in the wall’s space makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes that save if it enters the wall’s space or ends it turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.
preparedSpells.summary: Создаёт стену вращающихся клинков: труднопроходимую местность, укрытие и рубящий урон при опасном контакте. Спасбросок Ловкости уменьшает урон.

preparedSpells.name: Благословение · Bless
preparedSpells.description: You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
preparedSpells.summary: До трёх существ добавляют 1d4 к броскам атак и спасброскам, пока вы удерживаете концентрацию. Ячейка выше 1 круга увеличивает число целей.

preparedSpells.name: Слепота/глухота · Blindness/Deafness
preparedSpells.description: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has the Blinded or Deafened condition (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.
preparedSpells.summary: При провале спасброска Телосложения цель становится слепой или глухой. Концентрация не требуется; цель повторяет спасброски для прекращения эффекта.

preparedSpells.name: Умиротворение · Calm Emotions
preparedSpells.description: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature): • The creature has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the spell ends. If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed for the duration. • The creature becomes Indifferent about creatures of your choice that it’s Hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage. When the spell ends, the creature’s attitude returns to normal.
preparedSpells.summary: Подавляет сильные эмоции у гуманоидов: может временно снять влияние страха или очарования либо сделать враждебных существ безразличными. Урон способен нарушить успокоение.

preparedSpells.name: Приказ · Command
preparedSpells.description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. Choose the command from these options: Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you. Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn. Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. Grovel. The target has the Prone condition and then ends its turn. Halt. On its turn, the target doesn’t move and takes no action or Bonus Action. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can affect one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
preparedSpells.summary: Однословная команда при провале спасброска Мудрости заставляет цель потратить следующий ход на указанное простое действие. Не позволяет приказать напрямую навредить себе.

preparedSpells.name: Общение · Commune
preparedSpells.description: You contact a deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question. Divine beings aren’t necessarily omniscient, so you might receive “unclear” as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity’s knowledge. In a case where a one-word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity’s interests, the GM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead. If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.
preparedSpells.summary: Обратитесь к божественной силе с тремя вопросами, на которые можно ответить «да» или «нет». Ответ ограничен знаниями силы; частые повторения снижают надёжность.

preparedSpells.name: Призыв небожителя · Conjure Celestial
preparedSpells.description: You conjure a spirit from the Upper Planes, which manifests as a pillar of light in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. For each creature you can see in the Cylinder, choose which of these lights shines on it: Healing Light. The target regains Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Searing Light. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d12 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the spell ends, Bright Light fills the Cylinder, and when you move on your turn, you can also move the Cylinder up to 30 feet. Whenever the Cylinder moves into the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Cylinder or ends its turn there, you can bathe it in one of the lights. A creature can be affected by this spell only once per turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing and damage increase by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 7.
preparedSpells.summary: Магия небесного союзника. В 2014 призывает небожителя; в 2024 создаёт область небесной энергии, которую можно использовать для урона врагам и лечения союзников.

preparedSpells.name: Заражение · Contagion
preparedSpells.description: Your touch inflicts a magical contagion. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 11d8 Necrotic damage and have the Poisoned condition. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. While Poisoned, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws made with the chosen ability. The target must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or failures. If the target succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends on the target. If the target fails three of the saves, the spell lasts for 7 days on it. Whenever the Poisoned target receives an effect that would end the Poisoned condition, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or the Poisoned condition doesn’t end on it.
preparedSpells.summary: Заражает цель магической болезнью. Спасброски Телосложения определяют продолжение и прекращение последствий; эффект конкретной редакции описан ниже.

preparedSpells.name: Вечный огонь · Continual Flame
preparedSpells.description: A flame springs from an object that you touch. The effect casts Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. It looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and consumes no fuel. The flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.
preparedSpells.summary: Создаёт постоянное магическое пламя, которое светит, но не греет и не расходует топливо. Требует расходуемого компонента.

preparedSpells.name: Власть над водами · Control Water
preparedSpells.description: Until the spell ends, you control any water inside an area you choose that is a Cube up to 100 feet on a side, using one of the following effects. As a Magic action on your later turns, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one. Flood. You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If you choose an area in a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave’s path are carried with it to the other side. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a 25 percent chance of capsizing. The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. If this effect produced a wave, the wave repeats on the start of your next turn while the flood effect lasts. Part Water. You part water in the area and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell’s area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. The water then slowly fills in the trench over the course of the next round until the normal water level is restored. Redirect Flow. You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. The water in the area moves as you direct it, but once it moves beyond the spell’s area, it resumes its flow based on the terrain. The water continues to move in the direction you chose until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. Whirlpool. You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area, which must be at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. The whirlpool lasts until you choose a different effect or the spell ends. The whirlpool is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Any creature in the water and within 25 feet of the whirlpool is pulled 10 feet toward it. When a creature enters the whirlpool for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d8 Bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature can swim away from the whirlpool only if it first takes an action to pull away and succeeds on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC.
preparedSpells.summary: Управляйте водой в большой области: поднимайте уровень, разделяйте, меняйте течение или создавайте водоворот. Способ управления можно менять действием.

preparedSpells.name: Создание или уничтожение воды · Create or Destroy Water
preparedSpells.description: You do one of the following: Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there. Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.
preparedSpells.summary: Создаёт или уничтожает воду в подходящем объёме, в том числе дождём в небольшой области. Не извлекает жидкость из живого существа.

preparedSpells.name: Лечение ран · Cure Wounds
preparedSpells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.
preparedSpells.summary: Касанием восстанавливает хиты: в 2014 1d8 + магическая характеристика, в 2024 2d8 + модификатор. Усиление ячейкой увеличивает лечение.

preparedSpells.name: Защита от смерти · Death Ward
preparedSpells.description: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends, the target instead drops to 1 Hit Point, and the spell ends. If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against the target, and the spell ends.
preparedSpells.summary: Защищает от первого падения до 0 хитов, оставляя 1 хит, либо отменяет подходящий эффект мгновенной смерти. После срабатывания заклинание заканчивается.

preparedSpells.name: Рассеивание добра и зла · Dispel Evil and Good
preparedSpells.description: For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions. Break Enchantment. As a Magic action, you touch a creature that is possessed by or has the Charmed or Frightened condition from one or more creatures of the types above. The target is no longer possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such creatures. Dismissal. As a Magic action, you target one creature you can see within 5 feet of you that has one of the creature types above. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane if it isn’t there already. If they aren’t on their home plane, Undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and Fey are sent to the Feywild.
preparedSpells.summary: Защищает от сверхъестественных существ и позволяет прекратить подходящее очарование, испуг или одержимость либо попытаться изгнать пришельца на родной план.

preparedSpells.name: Врата · Gate
preparedSpells.description: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose. The portal lasts for the duration, and the portal’s destination is visible through it. The portal has a front and a back on each plane where it appears. Travel through the portal is possible only by moving through its front. Anything that does so is instantly transported to the other plane, appearing in the unoccupied space nearest to the portal. Deities and other planar rulers can prevent portals created by this spell from opening in their presence or anywhere within their domains. When you cast this spell, you can speak the name of a specific creature (a pseudonym, title, or nickname doesn’t work). If that creature is on a plane other than the one you are on, the portal opens next to the named creature and transports it to the nearest unoccupied space on your side of the portal. You gain no special power over the creature, and it is free to act as the GM deems appropriate. It might leave, attack you, or help you.
preparedSpells.summary: Открывает большой портал на другой план. Может вызвать конкретное существо по истинному имени, но не даёт автоматического контроля над ним.

preparedSpells.name: Высшее восстановление · Greater Restoration
preparedSpells.description: You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it: • 1 Exhaustion level • The Charmed or Petrified condition • A curse, including the target’s Attunement to a cursed magic item • Any reduction to one of the target’s ability scores • Any reduction to the target’s Hit Point maximum
preparedSpells.summary: Снимает один из тяжёлых эффектов: истощение, определённые проклятия, снижение характеристик или максимума здоровья, окаменение либо очарование. Требует дорогого расходуемого компонента.

preparedSpells.name: Малое восстановление · Lesser Restoration
preparedSpells.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.
preparedSpells.summary: Снимает с цели одно подходящее состояние, например слепоту, глухоту, паралич или отравление. Время применения и лечение болезней зависят от редакции.

preparedSpells.name: Множественное лечение ран · Mass Cure Wounds
preparedSpells.description: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you can see within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each target regains Hit Points equal to 5d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.
preparedSpells.summary: Лечит до шести выбранных существ в области одним действием. Объём лечения зависит от редакции и круга ячейки.

preparedSpells.name: Массовое полное исцеление · Mass Heal
preparedSpells.description: A flood of healing energy flows from you into creatures around you. You restore up to 700 Hit Points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell also have the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions removed from them.
preparedSpells.summary: Распределяет огромный запас исцеления между видимыми существами и снимает указанные физические недуги. Не позволяет превысить максимум здоровья каждой цели.

preparedSpells.name: Множественное лечащее слово · Mass Healing Word
preparedSpells.description: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 3.
preparedSpells.summary: Бонусным действием на расстоянии лечит до шести видимых существ. Удобно для одновременной помощи нескольким упавшим союзникам.

preparedSpells.name: Слово силы: исцеление · Power Word Heal
preparedSpells.description: A wave of healing energy washes over one creature you can see within range. The target regains all its Hit Points. If the creature has the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned condition, the condition ends. If the creature has the Prone condition, it can use its Reaction to stand up.
preparedSpells.summary: Мощное слово полностью восстанавливает хиты цели и прекращает ряд тяжёлых состояний. Может помочь немедленно подняться с земли.

preparedSpells.name: Возрождение · Revivify
preparedSpells.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can’t revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
preparedSpells.summary: Возвращает существо, умершее не более минуты назад, с 1 хитом. Требует алмазов и не восстанавливает отсутствующие части тела.

features.name: Использование заклинаний
features.description: Вы получаете магию класса. Выберите заговоры и заклинания в списках ниже: у каждого есть описание, время, дальность и длительность. Заговоры не тратят ячейки; остальные обычно требуют ячейку своего или более высокого круга. Число доступных выборов и ячеек рассчитано для 1 уровня редакции 2024. Подготовленные заклинания образуют ваш текущий доступный набор; бесплатные заклинания происхождения и подкласса показаны отдельно. Бонус атаки заклинанием = мастерство + магическая характеристика, сложность спасброска = 8 + те же бонусы.
features.originalDescription: You have learned to cast spells through prayer and meditation. See “Spells” for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules with Cleric spells, which appear on the Cleric spell list later in the class’s description. Cantrips. You know three cantrips of your choice from the Cleric spell list. Guidance, Sacred Flame, and Thaumaturgy are recommended. Whenever you gain a Cleric level, you can replace one of your cantrips with another cantrip of your choice from the Cleric spell list. Cleric Features Proficiency Bonus Channel Divinity Prepared Spells ——Spell Slots per Spell Level—— Level Class Features Cantrips +2 Spellcasting, Divine Order — — — — — — — — — +2 Channel Divinity — — — — — — — — +2 Cleric Subclass — — — — — — — +2 Ability Score Improvement — — — — — — — +3 Sear Undead — — — — — — +3 Subclass feature — — — — — — +3 Blessed Strikes — — — — — +3 Ability Score Improvement — — — — — +4 — — — — — +4 Divine Intervention — — — — +4 — — — — +4 Ability Score Improvement — — — +5 — — — +5 Improved Blessed Strikes — — +5 — — +5 Ability Score Improvement — +6 Subclass feature +6 — +6 Epic Boon +6 Greater Divine Intervention When you reach Cleric levels 4 and 10, you learn another cantrip of your choice from the Cleric spell list, as shown in the Cantrips column of the Cleric Features table. Spell Slots. The Cleric Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest. Prepared Spells of Level 1+. You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose four level 1 spells from the Cleric spell list. Bless, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, and Shield of Faith are recommended. The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Cleric levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Cleric Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional spells from the Cleric spell list until the number of spells on your list matches the number on the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you’re a level 3 Cleric, your list of prepared spells can include six spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination. If another Cleric feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don’t count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Cleric spells for you. Changing Your Prepared Spells. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your list of prepared spells, replacing any of the spells there with other Cleric spells for which you have spell slots. Spellcasting Ability. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your Cleric spells. Spellcasting Focus. You can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus for your Cleric spells.

features.name: Божественный орден
features.description: Выберите путь: Защитник даёт воинское оружие и тяжёлые доспехи; Чудотворец — дополнительный заговор жреца и бонус Мудрости (минимум +1) к проверкам Магии и Религии.
features.originalDescription: You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice. Protector. Trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Heavy armor. Thaumaturge. You know one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list. In addition, your mystical connection to the divine gives you a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks. The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).

features.name: Божественный канал
features.description: Ограниченный ресурс божественной силы. Конкретное применение выбирается при использовании: жрец может изгонять нежить, а домен или клятва добавляют свои варианты. Расходуется одно использование за эффект; точное число и восстановление приведены в правилах класса ниже.
features.originalDescription: You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Divine Spark and Turn Undead, each of which is described below. Each time you use this class’s Channel Divinity, choose which Channel Divinity effect from this class to create. You gain additional effect options at higher Cleric levels. You can use this class’s Channel Divinity twice. You regain one of its expended uses when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You gain additional uses when you reach certain Cleric levels, as shown in the Channel Divinity column of the Cleric Features table. If a Channel Divinity effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals the spell save DC from this class’s Spellcasting feature. Divine Spark. As a Magic action, you point your Holy Symbol at another creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself and focus divine energy at it. Roll 1d8 and add your Wisdom modifier. You either restore Hit Points to the creature equal to that total or force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to that total. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage (round down). You roll an additional d8 when you reach Cleric levels 7 (2d8), 13 (3d8), and 18 (4d8). Turn Undead. As a Magic action, you present your Holy Symbol and censure Undead creatures. Each Undead of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its save, it has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions for 1 minute. For that duration, it tries to move as far from you as it can on its turns. This effect ends early on the creature if it takes any damage, if you have the Incapacitated condition, or if you die.

features.name: Выбор подкласса
features.description: На этом уровне открывается специализация класса. Выберите подкласс: его особенности описаны в карточке, а новые способности будут появляться на следующих шагах развития.
features.originalDescription: You gain a Cleric subclass of your choice. The Life Domain subclass is detailed after this class’s description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Cleric levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass’s features that are of your Cleric level or lower.

features.name: Поборник жизни
features.description: Когда заклинание с затратой ячейки восстанавливает существу хиты, оно восстанавливает дополнительно 2 + круг ячейки. В 2024 бонус применяется в ход наложения; в 2014 действует формулировка для заклинания 1 круга и выше.
features.originalDescription: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot’s level.

features.name: Заклинания домена жизни
features.description: Заклинания домена жизни автоматически добавляются по уровням и всегда подготовлены, не занимая обычный лимит. Они показаны в книге заклинаний готового листа.
features.originalDescription: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Life Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared. Life Domain Spells Cleric Level Prepared Spells Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration Mass Healing Word, Revivify Aura of Life, Death Ward Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds

features.name: Сохранение жизни
features.description: Действием и использованием Божественного канала распределите между существами в 30 футах запас исцеления, равный пятикратному уровню жреца. Нельзя восстановить цели больше половины её максимума хитов. В 2014 не действует на нежить и конструктов.
features.originalDescription: As a Magic action, you present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to evoke healing energy that can restore a number of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level. Choose Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of yourself (which can include you), and divide those Hit Points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its Hit Point maximum.

features.name: Улучшение характеристик
features.description: +2 к одной характеристике или +1 к двум разным; значение не может превысить 20. Вместо повышения можно выбрать доступную черту, если выполнены её требования.
features.originalDescription: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see “Feats”) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Cleric levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Опаление нежити
features.description: При изгнании нежити можно добавить урон излучением каждой провалившей спасбросок цели: число d8 равно модификатору Мудрости, минимум одна кость. Этот урон не прекращает само изгнание.
features.originalDescription: Whenever you use Turn Undead, you can roll a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1d8) and add the rolls together. Each Undead that fails its saving throw against that use of Turn Undead takes Radiant damage equal to the roll’s total. This damage doesn’t end the turn effect.

features.name: Благословенный целитель
features.description: Когда лечите другое существо заклинанием 1 круга или выше, сами восстанавливаете 2 + круг хитов. В 2024 требуется потраченная ячейка, и применяется её круг.
features.originalDescription: The healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. Immediately after you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to one or more creatures other than yourself, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot’s level.

features.name: Благословенные удары
features.description: Выберите усиление: Божественный удар добавляет 1d8 некротического урона или излучения одному попаданию оружием в свой ход; Мощное колдовство добавляет модификатор Мудрости к урону заговоров жреца.
features.originalDescription: Divine power infuses you in battle. You gain one of the following options of your choice (if you get either option from a Cleric subclass in an older book, use only the option you choose for this feature). Divine Strike. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon, you can cause the target to take an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice). Potent Spellcasting. Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any Cleric cantrip.

features.name: Божественное вмешательство
features.description: В 2014 действием просите божество о помощи и бросаете d100: успех, если результат не выше уровня жреца; после успеха повтор через 7 дней, после неудачи — после долгого отдыха. В 2024 действием выбираете заклинание жреца до 5 круга без времени накладывания «реакция» и применяете без ячейки и материальных компонентов, раз за долгий отдых.
features.originalDescription: You can call on your deity or pantheon to intervene on your behalf. As a Magic action, choose any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower that doesn’t require a Reaction to cast. As part of the same action, you cast that spell without expending a spell slot or needing Material components. You can’t use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Улучшенные благословенные удары
features.description: Улучшает выбранный вариант: Божественный удар наносит уже 2d8 дополнительного урона; Мощное колдовство после урона заговором даёт вам или существу в 60 футах временные хиты в размере удвоенной Мудрости (минимум 2).
features.originalDescription: The option you chose for Blessed Strikes grows more powerful. Divine Strike. The extra damage of your Divine Strike increases to 2d8. Potent Spellcasting. When you cast a Cleric cantrip and deal damage to a creature with it, you can give vitality to yourself or another creature within 60 feet of yourself, granting a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Высшее исцеление
features.description: Когда нужно бросить кости для лечения заклинанием, используйте максимальный результат каждой кости. Например, 2d6 восстанавливает 12 вместо броска.
features.originalDescription: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore Hit Points to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, don’t roll those dice for the healing; instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring 2d6 Hit Points to a creature with a spell, you restore 12.

features.name: Эпический дар
features.description: Выберите доступную черту эпического дара. Она даёт мощную особенность и повышение одной разрешённой характеристики на 1, максимум до 30. Эффект каждого дара описан в его карточке.
features.originalDescription: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see “Feats”) or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Fate is recommended.

features.name: Высшее божественное вмешательство
features.description: Для Божественного вмешательства можно выбрать Исполнение желаний. Если выбран этот вариант, следующее Божественное вмешательство доступно через 2d4 долгих отдыха.
features.originalDescription: You can call on even more powerful divine intervention. When you use your Divine Intervention feature, you can choose Wish when you select a spell. If you do so, you can’t use Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 Long Rests.

features.name: Акробатика
features.description: Удержать равновесие, пройти по узкому выступу, устоять на скользкой поверхности или выполнить акробатический трюк. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Ловкость.

features.name: Бдительный
features.description: Добавьте бонус мастерства к инициативе. В начале боя можно обменяться инициативой с согласным союзником.

features.name: Защитник
features.description: Воинское оружие и тяжёлые доспехи.

features.name: Божественный удар
features.description: Раз за ход +1d8 некротического или лучистого урона оружием.

traits: героическое вдохновение после долгого отдыха, навык и черта происхождения на выбор.

feats.name: Бдительный
feats.description: Добавьте бонус мастерства к инициативе. В начале боя можно обменяться инициативой с согласным союзником.

feats.name: Дикий атакующий
feats.description: Раз за ход при попадании оружием бросьте кости урона дважды и используйте один из результатов.

feats.name: Эпический дар: Истинное зрение
feats.description: Истинное зрение 60 футов: видите невидимые объекты и существ, автоматически распознаёте зрительные иллюзии, видите истинные формы преображённых существ и Эфирный план. +1 к характеристике (максимум 30).

warnings: КД рассчитан без доспехов и щита. Снаряжение, языки, инструменты и расходуемые ресурсы внесите в заметки по правилам кампании.
Один класс, фиксированный прирост хитов. Подклассы и черты — выбранная открытая подборка; мультикласс и другие книги не включены.

choices.name: Умелый: дополнительный навык
choices.description: Выберите доступные варианты. Выбор сохраняется в листе персонажа.

options.name: Акробатика
options.description: Удержать равновесие, пройти по узкому выступу, устоять на скользкой поверхности или выполнить акробатический трюк. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Ловкость.

options.name: Уход за животными
options.description: Успокоить животное, понять его намерения или удержать контроль над испуганным ездовым животным. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

options.name: Магия
options.description: Вспомнить сведения о заклинаниях, магических традициях, символах, планах существования и их обитателях. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

options.name: Обман
options.description: Убедительно солгать, скрыть намерения, отвлечь собеседника обманом или выдать себя за другого. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

options.name: Расследование
options.description: Сопоставить улики, сделать выводы, найти скрытый механизм или понять, как устроена ловушка. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

options.name: Медицина
options.description: Распознать болезнь или причину смерти, оказать первую помощь. Для стабилизации умирающего обычно нужна проверка со сложностью 10. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

options.name: Природа
options.description: Определить растения и животных, вспомнить сведения о местности, погоде и природных циклах. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

options.name: Внимательность
options.description: Заметить спрятавшегося врага, услышать шаги или уловить другой признак опасности. Пассивное значение обычно равно 10 + бонус навыка. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

options.name: Выступление
options.description: Увлечь публику музыкой, танцем, актёрской игрой или рассказом. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

options.name: Убеждение
options.description: Договориться честными доводами, соблюсти этикет, попросить о помощи или мирно разрешить спор. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Харизма.

options.name: Религия
options.description: Вспомнить сведения о богах, культах, священных символах, ритуалах и религиозных традициях. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Интеллект.

options.name: Ловкость рук
options.description: Незаметно спрятать небольшой предмет, подбросить что-то или обчистить карман. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Ловкость.

options.name: Скрытность
options.description: Передвигаться незаметно, прятаться и избегать внимания. Нужны подходящие условия: на открытом виду спрятаться обычно нельзя. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Ловкость.

options.name: Выживание
options.description: Выслеживать существ, ориентироваться в дикой местности, находить пищу и воду, предсказывать природные опасности. Владение добавляет бонус мастерства к проверке Мудрость.

choices.name: Универсальность: черта происхождения
choices.description: Выберите доступные варианты. Выбор сохраняется в листе персонажа.

options.name: Бдительный
options.description: Добавьте бонус мастерства к инициативе. В начале боя можно обменяться инициативой с согласным союзником.

options.name: Посвящённый в магию: жрец
options.description: Два заговора и одно заклинание 1 круга из выбранного списка. Заклинание один раз за долгий отдых бесплатно; также можно использовать ячейки.

options.name: Посвящённый в магию: друид
options.description: Два заговора и одно заклинание 1 круга из выбранного списка. Заклинание один раз за долгий отдых бесплатно; также можно использовать ячейки.

options.name: Посвящённый в магию: волшебник
options.description: Два заговора и одно заклинание 1 круга из выбранного списка. Заклинание один раз за долгий отдых бесплатно; также можно использовать ячейки.

choices.name: Божественный орден
choices.description: Выберите доступные варианты. Выбор сохраняется в листе персонажа.

options.name: Защитник
options.description: Воинское оружие и тяжёлые доспехи.

options.name: Чудотворец
options.description: Дополнительный заговор; бонус Мудрости к Магии и Религии.

choices.name: Благословенные удары
choices.description: Выберите доступные варианты. Выбор сохраняется в листе персонажа.

options.name: Божественный удар
options.description: Раз за ход +1d8 некротического или лучистого урона оружием.

options.name: Мощное колдовство
options.description: Добавьте Мудрость к урону заговоров жреца.

class.name: Друид
class.description: Магия природы и превращение в зверей.

subclasses.name: Круг земли
subclasses.description: Круг земли расширяет список подготовленных заклинаний в зависимости от выбранной местности и помогает восстанавливать магические ресурсы. Смена местности и особенности восстановления зависят от редакции.

species.name: Человек
traits: 2014: +1 ко всем характеристикам.
2024: героическое вдохновение после долгого отдыха, навык и черта происхождения на выбор.

background.name: Солдат
background.description: Военная выучка и жизнь в строю.

selectedSpells.name: Дружба с животными · Animal Friendship
selectedSpells.description: Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spells ends. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.
selectedSpells.summary: Убедите зверя, что вы не представляете угрозы: при провале спасброска Мудрости он очарован. Урон от вас или союзников прекращает эффект.

selectedSpells.name: Очарование личности · Charm Person
selectedSpells.description: One Humanoid you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
selectedSpells.summary: Очаровывает гуманоида при провале спасброска Мудрости. В бою ему проще сопротивляться; после окончания он понимает, что на него воздействовали магией.

selectedSpells.name: Создание или уничтожение воды · Create or Destroy Water
selectedSpells.description: You do one of the following: Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there. Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.
selectedSpells.summary: Создаёт или уничтожает воду в подходящем объёме, в том числе дождём в небольшой области. Не извлекает жидкость из живого существа.

selectedSpells.name: Лечение ран · Cure Wounds
selectedSpells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.
selectedSpells.summary: Касанием восстанавливает хиты: в 2014 1d8 + магическая характеристика, в 2024 2d8 + модификатор. Усиление ячейкой увеличивает лечение.

selectedSpells.name: Разговор с животными · Speak with Animals
